<a id="dds-layer-core-status-inconsistenttopicstatus"></a>

<a id="inconsistenttopicstatus"></a>

## InconsistentTopicStatus

This status changes every time an inconsistent remote Topic is discovered,
that is, one with the same name but different characteristics than the current Topic.
See [`InconsistentTopicStatus`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/inconsistenttopicstatus.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds23InconsistentTopicStatusE).

List of status data members:

| Data Member Name                                                                                                                               | Type      |
|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| [`total_count`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/basestatus.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10BaseStatus11total_countE)               | `int32_t` |
| [`total_count_change`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/basestatus.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10BaseStatus18total_count_changeE) | `int32_t` |
* [`total_count`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/basestatus.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10BaseStatus11total_countE):
  Total cumulative count of inconsistent Topics discovered
  since the creation of the current Topic.
* [`total_count_change`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/basestatus.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10BaseStatus18total_count_changeE):
  The change in [`total_count`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/basestatus.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10BaseStatus11total_countE) since
  the last time [`on_inconsistent_topic()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/topic/topiclistener.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds13TopicListener21on_inconsistent_topicEP5Topic23InconsistentTopicStatus) was called or the status was read.

#### NOTE
**[Pro]** This status is only supported in *Fast DDS* **[Pro]**.
In *Fast DDS*, trying to access this status returns `NOT_SUPPORTED` and the corresponding listener is never
called.

<a id="dds-layer-core-status-dataonreaders"></a>

<a id="dataonreaders"></a>

## DataOnReaders

This status becomes active every time there is new data available for the application on any
DataReader belonging to the current Subscriber.
There is no getter function to access this status, as it does not keep track of any information related to the
data itself.
Its only purpose is to trigger the [`on_data_on_readers()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/subscriber/subscriberlistener.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds18SubscriberListener18on_data_on_readersEP10Subscriber) callback on the listener attached to the
DataReader.

<a id="dds-layer-core-status-dataavailable"></a>

<a id="dataavailable"></a>

## DataAvailable

This status becomes active every time there is new data available for the application on the
DataReader.
There is no getter function to access this status, as it does not keep track of any information related to the
data itself.
Its only purpose is to trigger the [`on_data_available()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/subscriber/datareaderlistener.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds18DataReaderListener17on_data_availableEP10DataReader) callback on the listener attached to the
DataReader.

<a id="dds-layer-core-status-livelinesschangedstatus"></a>

<a id="livelinesschangedstatus"></a>

## LivelinessChangedStatus

This status changes every time the liveliness status of a matched DataWriter has changed.
Either because a DataWriter that was *inactive* has become *active* or the other way around.
See [`LivelinessChangedStatus`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/livelinesschangedstatus.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds23LivelinessChangedStatusE).

List of status data members:

| Data Member Name                                                                                                                                                                   | Type                                                                                                                                         |
|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| [`alive_count`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/livelinesschangedstatus.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds23LivelinessChangedStatus11alive_countE)                         | `int32_t`                                                                                                                                    |
| [`not_alive_count`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/livelinesschangedstatus.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds23LivelinessChangedStatus15not_alive_countE)                 | `int32_t`                                                                                                                                    |
| [`alive_count_change`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/livelinesschangedstatus.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds23LivelinessChangedStatus18alive_count_changeE)           | `int32_t`                                                                                                                                    |
| [`not_alive_count_change`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/livelinesschangedstatus.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds23LivelinessChangedStatus22not_alive_count_changeE)   | `int32_t`                                                                                                                                    |
| [`last_publication_handle`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/livelinesschangedstatus.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds23LivelinessChangedStatus23last_publication_handleE) | [`InstanceHandle_t`](../../../api_reference/rtps/common/InstanceHandle/InstanceHandle_t.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds4rtps16InstanceHandle_tE) |
* [`alive_count`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/livelinesschangedstatus.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds23LivelinessChangedStatus11alive_countE):
  Total number of currently active DataWriters.
  This count increases every time a newly matched DataWriter asserts its
  liveliness or a DataWriter that was considered not alive reasserts its
  liveliness.
  It decreases every time an active DataWriter becomes not alive, either
  because it failed to assert its liveliness or because it was deleted for any reason.
* [`not_alive_count`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/livelinesschangedstatus.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds23LivelinessChangedStatus15not_alive_countE):
  Total number of matched DataWriters
  that are currently considered not alive.
  This count increases every time an active DataWriter becomes not alive
  because it fails to assert its liveliness.
  It decreases every time a DataWriter that was considered not alive
  reasserts its liveliness.
  Normal matching and unmatching of DataWriters
  does not affect this count.
* [`alive_count_change`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/livelinesschangedstatus.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds23LivelinessChangedStatus18alive_count_changeE):
  The change in [`alive_count`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/livelinesschangedstatus.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds23LivelinessChangedStatus11alive_countE) since
  the last time [`on_liveliness_changed()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/subscriber/datareaderlistener.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds18DataReaderListener21on_liveliness_changedEP10DataReaderRK23LivelinessChangedStatus) was called or the status was read.
  It can have positive or negative values.
* [`not_alive_count_change`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/livelinesschangedstatus.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds23LivelinessChangedStatus22not_alive_count_changeE):
  The change in [`not_alive_count`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/livelinesschangedstatus.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds23LivelinessChangedStatus15not_alive_countE) since
  the last time [`on_liveliness_changed()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/subscriber/datareaderlistener.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds18DataReaderListener21on_liveliness_changedEP10DataReaderRK23LivelinessChangedStatus) was called or the status was read.
  It can have positive or negative values.
* [`last_publication_handle`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/livelinesschangedstatus.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds23LivelinessChangedStatus23last_publication_handleE):

<a id="dds-layer-core-status-qospolicycountseq"></a>

<a id="qospolicycountseq"></a>

### QosPolicyCountSeq

Holds a [QosPolicyCount](#dds-layer-core-status-qospolicycount) for each [Policy](../policy/policy.md#dds-layer-core-policy),
indexed by its [`QosPolicyId_t`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/policy/qospolicyid_t.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds13QosPolicyId_tE). Therefore, the Qos Policy with ID `N` will be at position `N` in the sequence.
See [`QosPolicyCountSeq`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/qospolicycountseq.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds17QosPolicyCountSeqE).

```c++
DataReader* reader_ =
        subscriber_->create_datareader(topic_, DATAREADER_QOS_DEFAULT);

// Get how many times ReliabilityQosPolicy was not compatible with a remote writer
RequestedIncompatibleQosStatus status;
reader_->get_requested_incompatible_qos_status(status);
uint32_t incompatible_reliability_count = status.policies[RELIABILITY_QOS_POLICY_ID].count;
```

<a id="dds-layer-core-status-sampleloststatus"></a>

<a id="sampleloststatus"></a>

## SampleLostStatus

This status changes every time a new data sample is lost and will never be received.
See [`SampleLostStatus`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/sampleloststatus.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds16SampleLostStatusE).

There are two different criteria for considering a sample as lost depending on the [`reliability()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/subscriber/datareaderqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds13DataReaderQos11reliabilityEv):

* When using [`BEST_EFFORT_RELIABILITY_QOS`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/policy/reliabilityqospolicykind.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds24ReliabilityQosPolicyKind27BEST_EFFORT_RELIABILITY_QOSE), a not yet received sample is considered lost whenever a sample with a
  greater sequence number is received.
* When using [`RELIABLE_RELIABILITY_QOS`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/policy/reliabilityqospolicykind.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds24ReliabilityQosPolicyKind24RELIABLE_RELIABILITY_QOSE), a not yet received sample is considered lost whenever the
  `DataWriter` informs, through an RTPS `HEARTBEAT` submessage, that the sample is not available anymore.

List of status data members:

| Data Member Name                                                                                                                               | Type      |
|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| [`total_count`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/basestatus.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10BaseStatus11total_countE)               | `int32_t` |
| [`total_count_change`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/basestatus.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10BaseStatus18total_count_changeE) | `int32_t` |
* [`total_count`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/basestatus.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10BaseStatus11total_countE): Total cumulative count of lost samples under the Topic
  of the current DataReader.
* [`total_count_change`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/basestatus.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10BaseStatus18total_count_changeE): The change in [`total_count`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/basestatus.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10BaseStatus11total_countE) since
  the last time [`on_sample_lost()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/subscriber/datareaderlistener.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds18DataReaderListener14on_sample_lostEP10DataReaderRK16SampleLostStatus) was called or the status was read.
  It can only be positive or zero.

<a id="dds-layer-core-status-samplerejectedstatuskind"></a>

<a id="samplerejectedstatuskind"></a>

### SampleRejectedStatusKind

In Fast DDS, samples can be rejected due to resource limit reasons.
However, the fact that the samples are rejected does not imply that they are lost, i.e. a rejected sample may be
accepted in the future.

[`SampleRejectedStatusKind`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/samplerejectedstatuskind.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds24SampleRejectedStatusKindE) specifies the reason of the rejection:

* [`NOT_REJECTED`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/samplerejectedstatuskind.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds24SampleRejectedStatusKind12NOT_REJECTEDE) specifies that the samples were not rejected.
* [`REJECTED_BY_SAMPLES_LIMIT`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/samplerejectedstatuskind.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds24SampleRejectedStatusKind25REJECTED_BY_SAMPLES_LIMITE) specifies that the samples were rejected because there were not enough resources to
  stored them.
  This can happen even when there are free resources if those resources must be guaranteed to be available for
  other samples.
  This situation, which arises in the RTPS layer, occurs when there are yet to be received samples with lower
  sequence number and there is not enough resources for all of them (because [`max_samples`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/policy/durabilityserviceqospolicy.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds26DurabilityServiceQosPolicy11max_samplesE) has been
  reached).
* [`REJECTED_BY_INSTANCES_LIMIT`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/samplerejectedstatuskind.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds24SampleRejectedStatusKind27REJECTED_BY_INSTANCES_LIMITE) specifies that the samples were rejected because there were not enough resources
  to allocate the samples’ instances.
  This situation, which arises in the DDS layer, more precisely in the in the `DataReader`’s history,
  occurs when the sample corresponds to a new instance for which the middleware should reserve resources but the
  history’s number of instances has already reached [`max_instances`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/policy/durabilityserviceqospolicy.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds26DurabilityServiceQosPolicy13max_instancesE).
* [`REJECTED_BY_SAMPLES_PER_INSTANCE_LIMIT`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/samplerejectedstatuskind.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds24SampleRejectedStatusKind38REJECTED_BY_SAMPLES_PER_INSTANCE_LIMITE) specifies that the samples were rejected because there were not
  enough resources within their instance to stored them.
  This situation, which arises in the DDS layer, more precisely in the `DataReader`’s history, occurs
  when the `DataReader` is configured with [`KEEP_ALL_HISTORY_QOS`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/policy/historyqospolicykind.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds20HistoryQosPolicyKind20KEEP_ALL_HISTORY_QOSE) and the instance’s number of samples
  has reached [`max_samples_per_instance`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/policy/durabilityserviceqospolicy.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds26DurabilityServiceQosPolicy24max_samples_per_instanceE).

  Handle to the last DataWriter
  that matched the DataReader.
  If no matching ever happened, it will have value [`c_InstanceHandle_Unknown`](../../../api_reference/rtps/common/InstanceHandle/c_InstanceHandle_Unknown.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds4rtps24c_InstanceHandle_UnknownE).

## LivelinessLostStatus

This status changes every time the DataWriter failed to assert its liveliness
during the period configured on its [DataWriterQos](../../publisher/dataWriter/dataWriter.md#dds-layer-publisher-datawriterqos).
This means that matched DataReader entities will consider the
DataWriter as no longer *alive*.
See [`LivelinessLostStatus`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/rtpslivelinessloststatus.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds20LivelinessLostStatusE).

| [`total_count_change`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/basestatus.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10BaseStatus18total_count_changeE) | `int32_t` |
* [`total_count`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/basestatus.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10BaseStatus11total_countE):
  Total cumulative count of times that the DataWriter
  failed to assert its liveliness during the period configured on its [DataWriterQos](../../publisher/dataWriter/dataWriter.md#dds-layer-publisher-datawriterqos),

  This count does not change when the DataWriter is already considered not *alive* and
  simply remains not *alive* for another liveliness period.

  The change in [`total_count`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/basestatus.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10BaseStatus11total_countE) since
  the last time [`on_liveliness_lost()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/publisher/datawriterlistener.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds18DataWriterListener18on_liveliness_lostEP10DataWriterRK20LivelinessLostStatus) was called or the status was read.
  It can only have zero or positive values.

<a id="dds-layer-core-waitsets"></a>

<a id="conditions-and-wait-sets"></a>

# Conditions and Wait-sets

Conditions (in conjunction with wait-sets) provide an alternative mechanism to allow the middleware
to notify communication status changes (including arrival of data) to the application.

This mechanism is wait-based. Its general use pattern is as follows:

* The application indicates which relevant information it wants to get, by means of [Condition](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/condition/condition.md#api-pim-condition)
  objects ([GuardCondition](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/condition/guardcondition.md#api-pim-guardcondition), [StatusCondition](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/condition/statuscondition.md#api-pim-statuscondition), or [ReadCondition](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/subscriber/readcondition.md#api-pim-readcondition))
  and attaching them to a [Wait-set](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/condition/waitset.md#api-pim-waitset) via the [`attach_condition()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/condition/waitset.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds7WaitSet16attach_conditionERK9Condition) call.
* It then waits on that [Wait-set](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/condition/waitset.md#api-pim-waitset) via the [`wait()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/condition/waitset.md#_CPPv4NK8eprosima7fastdds3dds7WaitSet4waitER12ConditionSeqKN3dds10Duration_tE)
  call until the trigger value of one or several [Condition](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/condition/condition.md#api-pim-condition) objects become true.
* It then uses the result of the [`wait()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/condition/waitset.md#_CPPv4NK8eprosima7fastdds3dds7WaitSet4waitER12ConditionSeqKN3dds10Duration_tE) (i.e., the list of [Condition](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/condition/condition.md#api-pim-condition) objects with
  trigger_value == true) to actually get the information by calling:
  * [`get_status_changes()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/entity.md#_CPPv4NK8eprosima7fastdds3dds6Entity18get_status_changesEv), then checking if any of the changes is relevant using the [`StatusMask::is_active()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/statusmask.md#_CPPv4NK8eprosima7fastdds3dds10StatusMask9is_activeE10StatusMask)
    method on the result and finally calling get_<communication_status> on the relevant Entity, when the condition is a StatusCondition and the status changes refer to plain communication status.
    Refer to [Status](../status/status.md#dds-layer-core-status) for additional information on the different statuses that can be queried.
  * [`get_status_changes()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/entity.md#_CPPv4NK8eprosima7fastdds3dds6Entity18get_status_changesEv) and then [`Subscriber::get_datareaders()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/subscriber/subscriber_class.md#_CPPv4NK8eprosima7fastdds3dds10Subscriber15get_datareadersERNSt6vectorIP10DataReaderEE) on the relevant Subscriber, when the condition is a
    StatusCondition and the status changes refer to DataOnReaders.
  * [`get_status_changes()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/entity.md#_CPPv4NK8eprosima7fastdds3dds6Entity18get_status_changesEv) and then [`DataReader::read()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/subscriber/datareader.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10DataReader4readER18LoanableCollectionR13SampleInfoSeqNSt7int32_tE15SampleStateMask13ViewStateMask17InstanceStateMask)/[`DataReader::take()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/subscriber/datareader.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10DataReader4takeER18LoanableCollectionR13SampleInfoSeqNSt7int32_tE15SampleStateMask13ViewStateMask17InstanceStateMask) on the relevant DataReader, when the condition is a
    StatusCondition and the status changes refer to DataAvailable.
  * Directly [`DataReader::read_w_condition()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/subscriber/datareader.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10DataReader16read_w_conditionER18LoanableCollectionR13SampleInfoSeqNSt7int32_tEP13ReadCondition)/[`DataReader::take_w_condition()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/subscriber/datareader.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10DataReader16take_w_conditionER18LoanableCollectionR13SampleInfoSeqNSt7int32_tEP13ReadCondition) on the DataReader with the [Condition](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/condition/condition.md#api-pim-condition) as a parameter,
    when it is a ReadCondition
* When a Condition is no longer relevant it can be detached from a [Wait-set](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/condition/waitset.md#api-pim-waitset) via the
  [`detach_condition()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/condition/waitset.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds7WaitSet16detach_conditionERK9Condition) call.

The first step is usually done in an initialization phase, while the others are put in the
application main loop.

```c++
class ApplicationJob
{
    WaitSet wait_set_;
    GuardCondition terminate_condition_;
    std::thread thread_;

    void main_loop()
    {
        // Main loop is repeated until the terminate condition is triggered
        while (false == terminate_condition_.get_trigger_value())
        {
            // Wait for any of the conditions to be triggered
            ReturnCode_t ret_code;
            ConditionSeq triggered_conditions;
            ret_code = wait_set_.wait(triggered_conditions, eprosima::fastdds::dds::c_TimeInfinite);
            if (RETCODE_OK != ret_code)
            {
                // ... handle error
                continue;
            }

            // Process triggered conditions
            for (Condition* cond : triggered_conditions)
            {
                StatusCondition* status_cond = dynamic_cast<StatusCondition*>(cond);
                if (nullptr != status_cond)
                {
                    Entity* entity = status_cond->get_entity();
                    StatusMask changed_statuses = entity->get_status_changes();

                    // Process status. Liveliness changed and data available are depicted as an example
                    if (changed_statuses.is_active(StatusMask::liveliness_changed()))
                    {
                        std::cout << "Liveliness changed reported for entity "
                                  << entity->get_instance_handle()
                                  << std::endl;
                    }

                    if (changed_statuses.is_active(StatusMask::data_available()))
                    {
                        std::cout << "Data avilable on reader " << entity->get_instance_handle() << std::endl;

                        FooSeq data_seq;
                        SampleInfoSeq info_seq;
                        DataReader* reader = static_cast<DataReader*>(entity);

                        // Process all the samples until no one is returned
                        while (RETCODE_OK == reader->take(data_seq, info_seq,
                                LENGTH_UNLIMITED, ANY_SAMPLE_STATE,
                                ANY_VIEW_STATE, ANY_INSTANCE_STATE))
                        {
                            // Both info_seq.length() and data_seq.length() will have the number of samples returned
                            for (FooSeq::size_type n = 0; n < info_seq.length(); ++n)
                            {
                                // Only samples with valid data should be accessed
                                if (info_seq[n].valid_data &&
                                        reader->is_sample_valid(&data_seq[n], &info_seq[n]))
                                {
                                    // Process sample on data_seq[n]
                                }
                            }

                            // must return the loaned sequences when done processing
                            reader->return_loan(data_seq, info_seq);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

public:

    ApplicationJob(
            const std::vector<DataReader*>& readers,
            const std::vector<DataWriter*>& writers)
    {
        // Add a GuardCondition, so we can signal the processing thread to stop
        wait_set_.attach_condition(terminate_condition_);

        // Add the status condition of every reader and writer
        for (DataReader* reader : readers)
        {
            wait_set_.attach_condition(reader->get_statuscondition());
        }
        for (DataWriter* writer : writers)
        {
            wait_set_.attach_condition(writer->get_statuscondition());
        }

        thread_ = std::thread(&ApplicationJob::main_loop, this);
    }

    ~ApplicationJob()
    {
        // Signal the GuardCondition to force the WaitSet to wake up
        terminate_condition_.set_trigger_value(true);
        // Wait for the thread to finish
        thread_.join();
    }

};

// Application initialization
ReturnCode_t ret_code;
std::vector<DataReader*> application_readers;
std::vector<DataWriter*> application_writers;

// Create the participant, topics, readers, and writers.
ret_code = create_dds_application(application_readers, application_writers);
if (RETCODE_OK != ret_code)
{
    // ... handle error
    return;
}

{
    ApplicationJob main_loop_thread(application_readers, application_writers);

    // ... wait for application termination signaling (signal handler, user input, etc)

    // ... Destructor of ApplicationJob takes care of stopping the processing thread
}

// Destroy readers, writers, topics, and participant
destroy_dds_application();
```

Calling the [`wait()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/condition/waitset.md#_CPPv4NK8eprosima7fastdds3dds7WaitSet4waitER12ConditionSeqKN3dds10Duration_tE) operation on the [Wait-set](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/condition/waitset.md#api-pim-waitset) will block the calling thread
if the trigger value of all the conditions attached to it are false.
The thread will wake up, and the [`wait()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/condition/waitset.md#_CPPv4NK8eprosima7fastdds3dds7WaitSet4waitER12ConditionSeqKN3dds10Duration_tE) operation will return RETCODE_OK, whenever the trigger value of any
of the attached conditions becomes true.

<a id="guardcondition"></a>

## GuardCondition

A condition for which the trigger value is completely controlled by the application via its
[`set_trigger_value()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/condition/guardcondition.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds14GuardCondition17set_trigger_valueEb) operation.

<a id="statuscondition"></a>

## StatusCondition

A condition that triggers whenever there are changes on the communication statuses of an Entity.

The sensitivity of the [StatusCondition](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/condition/statuscondition.md#api-pim-statuscondition) to a particular communication status is controlled by the
list of enabled_statuses set on the condition by means of the [`set_enabled_statuses()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/condition/statuscondition.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds15StatusCondition20set_enabled_statusesERK10StatusMask) operation.

<a id="dds-layer-core-readcondition"></a>

<a id="readcondition"></a>

## ReadCondition

A condition that triggers whenever the DataReader that created it contains at least a sample with
SampleState, ViewState, and InstanceState matching those of the ReadCondition.

The fact that the trigger value of a ReadCondition is dependent on the presence of samples on the
associated DataReader implies that a single take operation can potentially change the trigger value
of several ReadCondition conditions.
For example, if all samples are taken, any ReadCondition associated with the DataReader that were
triggered before, will see their trigger value changed to false.
Note that this does not guarantee that WaitSet objects that were separately attached to those
conditions will not be woken up.
Once we have trigger_value == true on a condition, it may wake up the attached [Wait-set](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/condition/waitset.md#api-pim-waitset).
The condition transitioning to trigger_value == false does not necessarily ‘unwakeup’ the [Wait-set](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/condition/waitset.md#api-pim-waitset),
as ‘unwakening’ may not be possible in general.
The consequence is that an application blocked on a [Wait-set](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/condition/waitset.md#api-pim-waitset) may return from the wait with a list
of conditions, some of which are no longer triggered.
This also may be the consequence of user actions.
A user manually calling [`set_trigger_value()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/condition/guardcondition.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds14GuardCondition17set_trigger_valueEb) could potentially trigger the same behavior.
This is unavoidable if multiple threads are concurrently waiting on separate [Wait-set](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/condition/waitset.md#api-pim-waitset) objects and
taking data associated with the same DataReader entity.

To elaborate further, consider the following example:
A ReadCondition that has a sample_state_mask = {NOT_READ} will have trigger_value == true whenever
a new sample arrives and will transition to false as soon as all the newly-arrived samples are
either read (so their status changes to READ) or taken (so they are no longer managed by the
DataReader).
However, if the same ReadCondition had a sample_state_mask = {READ, NOT_READ}, then the
trigger_value would only become false once all the newly-arrived samples are taken (it is not
sufficient to read them as that would only change the SampleState to READ which overlaps the mask
on the ReadCondition).

<!-- Source: https://fast-dds.docs.eprosima.com/en/latest/fastdds/dds_layer/domain/domain.md -->

<!-- {{{ X-Types API -->
<!-- }}} -->

<a id="dds-layer-domain"></a>

<a id="domain"></a>

# Domain

A domain represents a separate communication plane.
It creates a logical separation among the Entities that share a common communication infrastructure.
Conceptually, it can be seen as a *virtual network* linking all applications running on the same domain
and isolating them from applications running on different domains.
This way, several independent distributed applications can coexist in the same physical network without interfering,
or even being aware of each other.

Every domain has a unique identifier, called domainId, that is implemented as a `uint32` value.
Applications that share this domainId belong to the same domain and will be able to communicate.

For an application to be added to a domain, it must create an instance of
[DomainParticipant](domainParticipant/domainParticipant.md#dds-layer-domainparticipant) with the appropriate domainId.
Instances of DomainParticipant are created through the
[DomainParticipantFactory](domainParticipantFactory/domainParticipantFactory.md#dds-layer-domainparticipantfactory) singleton.

[Partitions](domainParticipant/partition.md#partitions) introduce another entity isolation level within the domain.
While DomainParticipant will be able to communicate with each other if they
are in the same domain, it is still possible to isolate their [Publishers](../publisher/publisher/publisher.md#dds-layer-publisher-publisher) and
[Subscribers](../subscriber/subscriber/subscriber.md#dds-layer-subscriber-subscriber) assigning them to different [Partitions](domainParticipant/partition.md#partitions).

<a id="dds-layer-domainparticipant"></a>

<a id="domainparticipant"></a>

# DomainParticipant

A [DomainParticipant](#dds-layer-domainparticipant) is the entry point of the application to a domain.
Every DomainParticipant is linked to a single domain from its creation,
and contains all the Entities related to that domain.
It also acts as a factory for [Publisher](../../publisher/publisher/publisher.md#dds-layer-publisher-publisher), [Subscriber](../../subscriber/subscriber/subscriber.md#dds-layer-subscriber-subscriber)
and [Topic](../../topic/topic/topic.md#dds-layer-topic-topic).

The behavior of the DomainParticipant can be modified with the QoS values
specified on DomainParticipantQos.
The QoS values can be set at the creation of the DomainParticipant,
or modified later with [`DomainParticipant::set_qos()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipant.md#_CPPv4NK8eprosima7fastdds3dds17DomainParticipant7set_qosERK20DomainParticipantQos) member function.

As an Entity, DomainParticipant accepts a [DomainParticipantListener](../domainParticipantListener/domainParticipantListener.md#dds-layer-domainparticipantlistener)
that will be notified of status changes on the DomainParticipant instance.

<a id="dds-layer-domainparticipantqos"></a>

<a id="domainparticipantqos"></a>

## DomainParticipantQos

[`DomainParticipantQos`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds20DomainParticipantQosE) controls the behavior of the DomainParticipant.
Internally it contains the following [`QosPolicy`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/policy/qospolicy.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds9QosPolicyE) objects:

| QosPolicy class                                                                                      | Accessor/Mutator                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | Mutable   |
|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| [UserDataQosPolicy](../../core/policy/standardQosPolicies.md#userdataqospolicy)                      | [`user_data()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantqos.md#_CPPv4NK8eprosima7fastdds3dds20DomainParticipantQos9user_dataEv)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | Yes       |
| [EntityFactoryQosPolicy](../../core/policy/standardQosPolicies.md#entityfactoryqospolicy)            | [`entity_factory()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantqos.md#_CPPv4NK8eprosima7fastdds3dds20DomainParticipantQos14entity_factoryEv)                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | Yes       |
| [ParticipantResourceLimitsQos](../../core/policy/eprosimaExtensions.md#participantresourcelimitsqos) | [`allocation()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantqos.md#_CPPv4NK8eprosima7fastdds3dds20DomainParticipantQos10allocationEv)                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | No        |
| [PropertyPolicyQos](../../core/policy/eprosimaExtensions.md#propertypolicyqos)                       | [`properties()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantqos.md#_CPPv4NK8eprosima7fastdds3dds20DomainParticipantQos10propertiesEv)                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | No        |
| [WireProtocolConfigQos](../../core/policy/eprosimaExtensions.md#wireprotocolconfigqos)               | [`wire_protocol()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantqos.md#_CPPv4NK8eprosima7fastdds3dds20DomainParticipantQos13wire_protocolEv)                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | No\*      |
| [TransportConfigQos](../../core/policy/eprosimaExtensions.md#transportconfigqos)                     | [`transport()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantqos.md#_CPPv4NK8eprosima7fastdds3dds20DomainParticipantQos9transportEv) and<br/>[`setup_transports()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds20DomainParticipantQos16setup_transportsEN4rtps17BuiltinTransportsERKN4rtps24BuiltinTransportsOptionsE) | No        |
| [FlowControllersQos](../../core/policy/eprosimaExtensions.md#flowcontrollersqos)                     | [`flow_controllers()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds20DomainParticipantQos16flow_controllersEv)                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | No        |
| [ThreadSettings](../../core/policy/eprosimaExtensions.md#threadsettingsqos)                          | [`builtin_controllers_sender_thread()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds20DomainParticipantQos33builtin_controllers_sender_threadEv)                                                                                                                                                                                  | No        |
| [ThreadSettings](../../core/policy/eprosimaExtensions.md#threadsettingsqos)                          | [`timed_events_thread()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds20DomainParticipantQos19timed_events_threadEv)                                                                                                                                                                                                              | No        |
| [ThreadSettings](../../core/policy/eprosimaExtensions.md#threadsettingsqos)                          | [`discovery_server_thread()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds20DomainParticipantQos23discovery_server_threadEv)                                                                                                                                                                                                      | No        |
| [ThreadSettings](../../core/policy/eprosimaExtensions.md#threadsettingsqos)                          | [`typelookup_service_thread()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds20DomainParticipantQos25typelookup_service_threadEv)                                                                                                                                                                                                  | No        |
| [ThreadSettings](../../core/policy/eprosimaExtensions.md#threadsettingsqos)                          | [`security_log_thread()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds20DomainParticipantQos19security_log_threadEv)                                                                                                                                                                                                              | No        |

#### IMPORTANT
The only mutable field in [WireProtocolConfigQos](../../core/policy/eprosimaExtensions.md#wireprotocolconfigqos) is [`m_DiscoveryServers`](../../../api_reference/rtps/attributes/DiscoverySettings.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds4rtps17DiscoverySettings18m_DiscoveryServersE), which is contained in
[`discovery_config`](../../../api_reference/rtps/attributes/BuiltinAttributes.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds4rtps17BuiltinAttributes16discovery_configE) within [`builtin`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/policy/wireprotocolconfigqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds21WireProtocolConfigQos7builtinE) (see
[Modifying remote servers list at run time](../../../discovery/discovery_server.md#ds-modify-server-list)).

#### IMPORTANT
Upon the call to [`create_participant()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantfactory.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds24DomainParticipantFactory18create_participantE10DomainId_tRK20DomainParticipantQosP25DomainParticipantListenerRK10StatusMask), if Fast DDS is compiled with statistics support
(enabled by default, see [CMake options](../../../../installation/configuration/cmake_options.md#cmake-options), and always in *Fast DDS* **[Pro]**), the internal
[`DomainParticipantQos`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds20DomainParticipantQosE) may differ from the input [`DomainParticipantQos`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds20DomainParticipantQosE)
(see [Statistics Module Settings](../../../property_policies/non_consolidated_qos.md#property-policies-statistics)).
This entails that applications willing to further modify the [`DomainParticipantQos`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds20DomainParticipantQosE) after
[`DomainParticipant`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipant.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds17DomainParticipantE) creation should:

1. Retrieve the internal [`DomainParticipantQos`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds20DomainParticipantQosE) by the means of [`DomainParticipant::get_qos()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipant.md#_CPPv4NK8eprosima7fastdds3dds17DomainParticipant7get_qosER20DomainParticipantQos).
2. Perform the desired modifications.
3. Update the [`DomainParticipantQos`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds20DomainParticipantQosE) by the means of [`DomainParticipant::set_qos()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipant.md#_CPPv4NK8eprosima7fastdds3dds17DomainParticipant7set_qosERK20DomainParticipantQos).

Refer to the detailed description of each QosPolicy class for more information about their usage and
default values.

The QoS value of a previously created DomainParticipant can be modified using the
[`DomainParticipant::set_qos()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipant.md#_CPPv4NK8eprosima7fastdds3dds17DomainParticipant7set_qosERK20DomainParticipantQos) member function.
Trying to modify an immutable QosPolicy on an already enabled DomainParticipant
will result on an error.
In such case, no changes will be applied and the DomainParticipant will keep its
previous DomainParticipantQos.

```c++
// Create a DomainParticipant with default DomainParticipantQos
DomainParticipant* participant =
        DomainParticipantFactory::get_instance()->create_participant(0, PARTICIPANT_QOS_DEFAULT);
if (nullptr == participant)
{
    // Error
    return;
}

// Get the current QoS or create a new one from scratch
DomainParticipantQos qos = participant->get_qos();

// Modify QoS attributes
qos.entity_factory().autoenable_created_entities = false;

// Assign the new Qos to the object
participant->set_qos(qos);
```

<a id="dds-layer-defaultdomainparticipantqos"></a>

<a id="default-domainparticipantqos"></a>

### Default DomainParticipantQos

The default DomainParticipantQos refers to the value returned by the
[`get_default_participant_qos()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantfactory.md#_CPPv4NK8eprosima7fastdds3dds24DomainParticipantFactory27get_default_participant_qosER20DomainParticipantQos) member function on the
[DomainParticipantFactory](../domainParticipantFactory/domainParticipantFactory.md#dds-layer-domainparticipantfactory) singleton.
The special value `PARTICIPANT_QOS_DEFAULT` can be used as QoS argument on
[`create_participant()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantfactory.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds24DomainParticipantFactory18create_participantE10DomainId_tRK20DomainParticipantQosP25DomainParticipantListenerRK10StatusMask)
or [`DomainParticipant::set_qos()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipant.md#_CPPv4NK8eprosima7fastdds3dds17DomainParticipant7set_qosERK20DomainParticipantQos) member functions to indicate that the current default
DomainParticipantQos should be used.

When the system starts, the default DomainParticipantQos is equivalent to the default constructed
value [`DomainParticipantQos()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds20DomainParticipantQos20DomainParticipantQosEv).
The default DomainParticipantQos can be modified at any time using the
[`set_default_participant_qos()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantfactory.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds24DomainParticipantFactory27set_default_participant_qosERK20DomainParticipantQos)
member function on the DomainParticipantFactory singleton.
Modifying the default DomainParticipantQos will not affect already existing
DomainParticipant instances.

```c++
// Get the current QoS or create a new one from scratch
DomainParticipantQos qos_type1 = DomainParticipantFactory::get_instance()->get_default_participant_qos();

// Modify QoS attributes
// (...)

// Set as the new default TopicQos
if (DomainParticipantFactory::get_instance()->set_default_participant_qos(qos_type1) !=
        RETCODE_OK)
{
    // Error
    return;
}

// Create a DomainParticipant with the new default DomainParticipantQos.
DomainParticipant* participant_with_qos_type1 =
        DomainParticipantFactory::get_instance()->create_participant(0, PARTICIPANT_QOS_DEFAULT);
if (nullptr == participant_with_qos_type1)
{
    // Error
    return;
}

// Get the current QoS or create a new one from scratch
DomainParticipantQos qos_type2;

// Modify QoS attributes
// (...)

// Set as the new default TopicQos
if (DomainParticipantFactory::get_instance()->set_default_participant_qos(qos_type2) !=
        RETCODE_OK)
{
    // Error
    return;
}

// Create a Topic with the new default TopicQos.
DomainParticipant* participant_with_qos_type2 =
        DomainParticipantFactory::get_instance()->create_participant(0, PARTICIPANT_QOS_DEFAULT);
if (nullptr == participant_with_qos_type2)
{
    // Error
    return;
}

// Resetting the default DomainParticipantQos to the original default constructed values
if (DomainParticipantFactory::get_instance()->set_default_participant_qos(PARTICIPANT_QOS_DEFAULT)
        != RETCODE_OK)
{
    // Error
    return;
}

// The previous instruction is equivalent to the following
if (DomainParticipantFactory::get_instance()->set_default_participant_qos(DomainParticipantQos())
        != RETCODE_OK)
{
    // Error
    return;
}
```

[`set_default_participant_qos()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantfactory.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds24DomainParticipantFactory27set_default_participant_qosERK20DomainParticipantQos)
member function also accepts the value `PARTICIPANT_QOS_DEFAULT`
as input argument.
This will reset the current default DomainParticipantQos to the default constructed value
[`DomainParticipantQos()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds20DomainParticipantQos20DomainParticipantQosEv).

```c++
// Create a custom DomainParticipantQos
DomainParticipantQos custom_qos;

// Modify QoS attributes
// (...)

// Create a DomainParticipant with a custom DomainParticipantQos

DomainParticipant* participant = DomainParticipantFactory::get_instance()->create_participant(0, custom_qos);
if (nullptr == participant)
{
    // Error
    return;
}

// Set the QoS on the participant to the default
if (participant->set_qos(PARTICIPANT_QOS_DEFAULT) != RETCODE_OK)
{
    // Error
    return;
}

// The previous instruction is equivalent to the following:
if (participant->set_qos(DomainParticipantFactory::get_instance()->get_default_participant_qos())
        != RETCODE_OK)
{
    // Error
    return;
}
```

#### NOTE
The value `PARTICIPANT_QOS_DEFAULT` has different meaning depending on where it is used:

* On [`create_participant()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantfactory.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds24DomainParticipantFactory18create_participantE10DomainId_tRK20DomainParticipantQosP25DomainParticipantListenerRK10StatusMask) and [`DomainParticipant::set_qos()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipant.md#_CPPv4NK8eprosima7fastdds3dds17DomainParticipant7set_qosERK20DomainParticipantQos) it refers to the
  default DomainParticipantQos as returned by [`get_default_participant_qos()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantfactory.md#_CPPv4NK8eprosima7fastdds3dds24DomainParticipantFactory27get_default_participant_qosER20DomainParticipantQos).
* On [`set_default_participant_qos()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantfactory.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds24DomainParticipantFactory27set_default_participant_qosERK20DomainParticipantQos) it refers to the default constructed
  [`DomainParticipantQos()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds20DomainParticipantQos20DomainParticipantQosEv).

<a id="dds-layer-domainparticipantextendedqos"></a>

<a id="domainparticipantextendedqos"></a>

## DomainParticipantExtendedQos

[`DomainParticipantExtendedQos`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantextendedqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds28DomainParticipantExtendedQosE) is an extension of [`DomainParticipantQos`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds20DomainParticipantQosE) that includes both
the `DomainId` and the [`DomainParticipantQos`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds20DomainParticipantQosE) objects of a DomainParticipant.
This class is useful for simplifying the creation and configuration of a DomainParticipant,
as it allows specifying all necessary settings in a single object.

This [`DomainParticipantExtendedQos`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantextendedqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds28DomainParticipantExtendedQosE) can be obtained from the loaded profiles with
[`get_participant_extended_qos_from_profile()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantfactory.md#_CPPv4NK8eprosima7fastdds3dds24DomainParticipantFactory41get_participant_extended_qos_from_profileERKNSt6stringER28DomainParticipantExtendedQos) and then create [`DomainParticipant`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipant.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds17DomainParticipantE)
with those [`DomainParticipantExtendedQos`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantextendedqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds28DomainParticipantExtendedQosE).
The QoS value of a previously created DomainParticipant can be modified similarly as when creating
the [`DomainParticipant`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipant.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds17DomainParticipantE) from [`DomainParticipantQos`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds20DomainParticipantQosE).

```c++
// Create a DomainParticipant with DomainParticipantExtendedQos from profile
DomainParticipantExtendedQos profile_extended_qos;
DomainParticipantFactory::get_instance()->get_participant_extended_qos_from_profile("participant_profile",
        profile_extended_qos);

DomainParticipant* participant =
        DomainParticipantFactory::get_instance()->create_participant(profile_extended_qos);
if (nullptr == participant)
{
    // Error
    return;
}
```

It is also possible to fill a [`DomainParticipantExtendedQos`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantextendedqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds28DomainParticipantExtendedQosE) object directly from a raw XML string without the need
to previously load any profile.
Please refer to [Get QoS from raw XML profiles](../../../xml_configuration/making_xml_profiles.md#loading-raw-xml-profiles) section for more information.

<!-- Source: https://fast-dds.docs.eprosima.com/en/latest/fastdds/dds_layer/domain/domainParticipantListener/domainParticipantListener.md -->

<!-- {{{ X-Types API -->
<!-- }}} -->

<a id="dds-layer-domainparticipantlistener"></a>

<a id="domainparticipantlistener"></a>

# DomainParticipantListener

[`DomainParticipantListener`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantlistener.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds25DomainParticipantListenerE) is an abstract class defining the callbacks that will be triggered
in response to state changes on the [DomainParticipant](../domainParticipant/domainParticipant.md#dds-layer-domainparticipant).
By default, all these callbacks are empty and do nothing.
The user should implement a specialization of this class overriding the callbacks
that are needed on the application.
Callbacks that are not overridden will maintain their empty implementation.

DomainParticipantListener inherits from [TopicListener](../../topic/topicListener/topicListener.md#dds-layer-topic-topiclistener),
[PublisherListener](../../publisher/publisherListener/publisherListener.md#dds-layer-publisher-publisherlistener), and [SubscriberListener](../../subscriber/subscriberListener/subscriberListener.md#dds-layer-subscriber-subscriberlistener).
Therefore, it has the ability to react to every kind of event that is
reported to any of its attached Entities.
Since events are always notified to the most specific Entity Listener that can handle the event,
callbacks that DomainParticipantListener inherits from other Listeners will only be called
if no other Entity was able to handle the event,
either because it has no Listener attached,
or because the callback is disabled by the [`StatusMask`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/status/statusmask.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10StatusMaskE) on the Entity.

Additionally, DomainParticipantListener adds the following non-standard callbacks:

* [`on_participant_discovery()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantlistener.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds25DomainParticipantListener24on_participant_discoveryEP17DomainParticipantN7fastdds4rtps26ParticipantDiscoveryStatusERK27ParticipantBuiltinTopicDataRb): A new DomainParticipant is discovered in the same domain,
  a previously known DomainParticipant has been removed, or some DomainParticipant
  has changed its QoS.
  This method provides an overload with an additional boolean output parameter so a discovery callback can tell the
  middleware if a newly discovered participant has to be ignored via the use of the
  [`ignore_participant()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipant.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds17DomainParticipant18ignore_participantERK16InstanceHandle_t).
  This overload should be used when there is a need to ignore participants inside the discovery callback, since calling
  [`ignore_participant()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipant.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds17DomainParticipant18ignore_participantERK16InstanceHandle_t) inside the listener might deadlock.
  If both callbacks are implemented, the discovery callback with the `should_be_ignored` boolean flag takes
  precedence.
  The second discovery callback is only executed if the discovered DomainParticipant is not ignored in the first
  callback (`should_be_ignored` parameter returns `false`).
* [`on_data_reader_discovery()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantlistener.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds25DomainParticipantListener24on_data_reader_discoveryEP17DomainParticipantN4rtps21ReaderDiscoveryStatusERK28SubscriptionBuiltinTopicDataRb): A new [DataReader](../../subscriber/dataReader/dataReader.md#dds-layer-subscriber-datareader) is discovered
  in the same domain, a previously known DataReader has been removed, or some DataReader has changed its QoS.
* [`on_data_writer_discovery()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantlistener.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds25DomainParticipantListener24on_data_writer_discoveryEP17DomainParticipantN4rtps21WriterDiscoveryStatusERK27PublicationBuiltinTopicDataRb): A new [DataWriter](../../publisher/dataWriter/dataWriter.md#dds-layer-publisher-datawriter) is discovered
  in the same domain, a previously known DataWriter has been removed, or some DataWriter has changed its QoS.
* [`onParticipantAuthentication()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantlistener.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds25DomainParticipantListener27onParticipantAuthenticationEP17DomainParticipantRRN4rtps29ParticipantAuthenticationInfoE): Informs about the result of the authentication process
  of a remote DomainParticipant (either on failure or success).
* [`should_endpoints_match()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantlistener.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds25DomainParticipantListener22should_endpoints_matchEPK17DomainParticipantRK28SubscriptionBuiltinTopicDataRK27PublicationBuiltinTopicData): Called after standard QoS matching rules have been
  evaluated for a pair of endpoints (a [DataReader](../../subscriber/dataReader/dataReader.md#dds-layer-subscriber-datareader) and a
  [DataWriter](../../publisher/dataWriter/dataWriter.md#dds-layer-publisher-datawriter) on the same topic with compatible QoS).
  It allows the application to apply custom matching logic as an additional filter on top of the standard rules.
  The callback receives the [`DomainParticipant`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipant.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds17DomainParticipantE) calling the listener, a
  `SubscriptionBuiltinTopicData` with the reader information, and a `PublicationBuiltinTopicData` with the
  writer information.
  Returning `true` allows the match to proceed; returning `false` prevents it.
  The default implementation always returns `true`.

#### IMPORTANT
For more information about callbacks and its hierarchy, please refer to
[Listener](../../core/entity/entity.md#dds-layer-core-entity-commonchars-listener).

```c++
class CustomDomainParticipantListener : public DomainParticipantListener
{

public:

    CustomDomainParticipantListener()
        : DomainParticipantListener()
    {
    }

    virtual ~CustomDomainParticipantListener()
    {
    }

    void on_participant_discovery(
            DomainParticipant* participant,
            eprosima::fastdds::rtps::ParticipantDiscoveryStatus status,
            const ParticipantBuiltinTopicData& info,
            bool& should_be_ignored) override
    {
        should_be_ignored = false;
        if (status == eprosima::fastdds::rtps::ParticipantDiscoveryStatus::DISCOVERED_PARTICIPANT)
        {
            std::cout << "New participant discovered" << std::endl;
            // The following line can be modified to evaluate whether the discovered participant should be ignored
            // (usually based on fields present in the discovery information)
            bool ignoring_condition = false;
            if (ignoring_condition)
            {
                should_be_ignored = true; // Request the ignoring of the discovered participant
            }
        }
        else if (status == eprosima::fastdds::rtps::ParticipantDiscoveryStatus::REMOVED_PARTICIPANT ||
                status == eprosima::fastdds::rtps::ParticipantDiscoveryStatus::DROPPED_PARTICIPANT)
        {
            std::cout << "Participant lost" << std::endl;
        }
    }

#if HAVE_SECURITY
    void onParticipantAuthentication(
            DomainParticipant* participant,
            eprosima::fastdds::rtps::ParticipantAuthenticationInfo&& info) override
    {
        if (info.status == eprosima::fastdds::rtps::ParticipantAuthenticationInfo::AUTHORIZED_PARTICIPANT)
        {
            std::cout << "A participant was authorized" << std::endl;
        }
        else if (info.status == eprosima::fastdds::rtps::ParticipantAuthenticationInfo::UNAUTHORIZED_PARTICIPANT)
        {
            std::cout << "A participant failed authorization" << std::endl;
        }
    }

#endif // if HAVE_SECURITY

    void on_data_reader_discovery(
            DomainParticipant* participant,
            eprosima::fastdds::rtps::ReaderDiscoveryStatus reason,
            const eprosima::fastdds::rtps::SubscriptionBuiltinTopicData& info,
            bool& should_be_ignored) override
    {
        should_be_ignored = false;
        if (reason == eprosima::fastdds::rtps::ReaderDiscoveryStatus::DISCOVERED_READER)
        {
            std::cout << "New datareader discovered" << std::endl;
            // The following line can be modified to evaluate whether the discovered datareader should be ignored
            // (usually based on fields present in the discovery information)
            bool ignoring_condition = false;
            if (ignoring_condition)
            {
                should_be_ignored = true; // Request the ignoring of the discovered datareader
            }
        }
        else if (reason == eprosima::fastdds::rtps::ReaderDiscoveryStatus::REMOVED_READER)
        {
            std::cout << "Datareader lost" << std::endl;
        }
    }

    void on_data_writer_discovery(
            DomainParticipant* participant,
            eprosima::fastdds::rtps::WriterDiscoveryStatus reason,
            const eprosima::fastdds::dds::PublicationBuiltinTopicData& info,
            bool& should_be_ignored) override
    {
        static_cast<void>(participant);
        static_cast<void>(info);

        should_be_ignored = false;
        if (reason == eprosima::fastdds::rtps::WriterDiscoveryStatus::DISCOVERED_WRITER)
        {
            std::cout << "New datawriter discovered" << std::endl;
            // The following line can be modified to evaluate whether the discovered datawriter should be ignored
            // (usually based on fields present in the discovery information)
            bool ignoring_condition = false;
            if (ignoring_condition)
            {
                should_be_ignored = true; // Request the ignoring of the discovered datawriter
            }
        }
        else if (reason == eprosima::fastdds::rtps::WriterDiscoveryStatus::REMOVED_WRITER)
        {
            std::cout << "Datawriter lost" << std::endl;
        }
    }

    bool should_endpoints_match(
            const DomainParticipant* participant,
            const eprosima::fastdds::rtps::SubscriptionBuiltinTopicData& reader_info,
            const eprosima::fastdds::dds::PublicationBuiltinTopicData& writer_info) override
    {
        static_cast<void>(participant);
        // For example, only allow matching between endpoints belonging to different participants.
        // This prevents intra-participant communication while still allowing
        // cross-participant communication for endpoints that pass standard QoS checks.
        return reader_info.participant_guid.guidPrefix != writer_info.participant_guid.guidPrefix;
    }

};
```

<a id="dds-layer-domain-congestioncontrollistener"></a>

<a id="congestioncontrollistener-pro"></a>

# CongestionControlListener **[Pro]**

`CongestionControlListener` is an abstract class that lets the application observe the
meta-information produced by the participant’s [congestion control](../../../use_cases/large_data/large_data.md#congestion-control)
mechanism.
It is purely observational, that is, implementing it does not change congestion-control behavior.

Congestion control is participant-scoped: there is a single controller per
[DomainParticipant](../domainParticipant/domainParticipant.md#dds-layer-domainparticipant), covering all reliable, non-builtin DataWriters and
evaluated independently for each remote DataReader.
The listener is therefore attached at the participant level through
[`set_congestion_control_listener()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipant.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds17DomainParticipant31set_congestion_control_listenerEPN7fastdds4rtps25CongestionControlListenerE), and only
takes effect when congestion control is enabled through the participant’s
[properties](../../../property_policies/congestion_control.md#property-policies-congestion-control).
For more information on congestion control, see [Congestion Control](../../../use_cases/large_data/large_data.md#congestion-control) .

As with other listeners, all callbacks have an empty default implementation, so the user
only needs to override the events of interest.

#### WARNING
The callbacks are invoked from the congestion-control evaluation thread.
The listener object must outlive the participant it is registered on (it is not copied),
and must not be destroyed while the participant is enabled.

<a id="callbacks"></a>

## Callbacks

`CongestionControlListener` defines the following callbacks:

* `on_cc_limit_update`: Called whenever the per-reader bandwidth limit changes, either an
  increase or a decrease.
  It receives a `CongestionControlLimitUpdateStatus` carrying the remote `reader_guid`,
  the `previous_limit` and `new_limit` (bytes per period) and the `direction` of the
  change (`INCREASE` or `DECREASE`).
* `on_cc_status_check`: Called once per remote reader on every periodic evaluation cycle,
  regardless of whether the limit changed.
  It receives a `CongestionControlStatus` snapshot with the remote `reader_guid`, the
  `current_limit`, the per-period byte counters (`period_sent_bytes`,
  `period_acked_bytes`, `period_resent_bytes`), the delivered throughput `acked_bps`,
  and the nominal `period_duration_ms`.
* `on_cc_info`: Generic algorithm-specific channel.
  It receives a `CongestionControlInfoStatus` with the remote `reader_guid` and a
  `{code, value}` pair whose meaning is defined by the active algorithm (see
  `CongestionControlInfoCodes.hpp`).
  For instance, the `basic` algorithm reports the bytes acknowledged, the percentage of
  bandwidth used, and the bytes resent during the period.

<a id="example"></a>

## Example

The following snippet shows a specialization of `CongestionControlListener`:

```c++
class CustomCongestionControlListener : public eprosima::fastdds::rtps::CongestionControlListener
{
    void on_cc_limit_update(
            const eprosima::fastdds::rtps::CongestionControlLimitUpdateStatus& status) override
    {
        std::cout << "Limit update for reader " << status.reader_guid
                  << ": " << status.previous_limit << " -> " << status.new_limit
                  << " (" << (status.direction ==
                eprosima::fastdds::rtps::CongestionControlLimitDirection::INCREASE
                              ? "increase" : "decrease") << ")" << std::endl;
    }

    void on_cc_status_check(
            const eprosima::fastdds::rtps::CongestionControlStatus& status) override
    {
        std::cout << "Status for reader " << status.reader_guid
                  << ": current_limit=" << status.current_limit
                  << ", acked_bps=" << status.acked_bps << std::endl;
    }

    void on_cc_info(
            const eprosima::fastdds::rtps::CongestionControlInfoStatus& status) override
    {
        // The meaning of the {code, value} pair depends on the active algorithm.
        // For the "basic" algorithm, the codes are defined in CongestionControlBasicInfoCode.
        switch (static_cast<eprosima::fastdds::rtps::CongestionControlBasicInfoCode>(status.code))
        {
            case eprosima::fastdds::rtps::CongestionControlBasicInfoCode::ACKS_RECEIVED:
                std::cout << "Reader " << status.reader_guid << " acked " << status.value
                          << " bytes during the period" << std::endl;
                break;
            case eprosima::fastdds::rtps::CongestionControlBasicInfoCode::BANDWIDTH_USED_PERCENT:
                std::cout << "Reader " << status.reader_guid << " used " << status.value
                          << "% of the current limit" << std::endl;
                break;
            case eprosima::fastdds::rtps::CongestionControlBasicInfoCode::RESENT_BYTES:
                std::cout << "Reader " << status.reader_guid << " had " << status.value
                          << " bytes resent during the period" << std::endl;
                break;
            default:
                std::cout << "Unknown congestion control info code: " << status.code << std::endl;
                break;
        }
    }

};
```

It can then be registered on a DomainParticipant on which congestion control has been
enabled:

```c++
        // Enable congestion control through the participant's properties
        DomainParticipantQos pqos = PARTICIPANT_QOS_DEFAULT;
        pqos.properties().properties().emplace_back("fastdds.congestion.plugin", "basic");

        DomainParticipant* participant =
                DomainParticipantFactory::get_instance()->create_participant(0, pqos);
        if (nullptr == participant)
        {
            // Error
            return;
        }

        // Attach the listener (must outlive the participant)
        CustomCongestionControlListener cc_listener;
        participant->set_congestion_control_listener(&cc_listener);

        // ...

        // Detach the listener before destroying it
        participant->set_congestion_control_listener(nullptr);
```

<a id="dds-layer-domainparticipantfactory"></a>

<a id="domainparticipantfactory"></a>

# DomainParticipantFactory

The sole purpose of this class is to allow the creation and destruction of [DomainParticipant](../domainParticipant/domainParticipant.md#dds-layer-domainparticipant) objects.
[`DomainParticipantFactory`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantfactory.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds24DomainParticipantFactoryE) itself has no factory, it is a singleton object that can be accessed
through the [`get_instance()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantfactory.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds24DomainParticipantFactory12get_instanceEv) static member function on the [`DomainParticipantFactory`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantfactory.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds24DomainParticipantFactoryE)
class.

The behavior of the DomainParticipantFactory can be modified with the QoS values
specified on [DomainParticipantFactoryQos](#dds-layer-domainparticipantfactoryqos).
Since the DomainParticipantFactory is a singleton, its QoS can only be modified with the
[`DomainParticipantFactory::set_qos()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantfactory.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds24DomainParticipantFactory7set_qosERK27DomainParticipantFactoryQos) member function.

DomainParticipantFactory does not accept any Listener, since it is not an Entity.

<a id="dds-layer-domainparticipantfactoryqos"></a>

<a id="domainparticipantfactoryqos"></a>

## DomainParticipantFactoryQos

DomainParticipantFactoryQos controls the behavior of the [DomainParticipantFactory](#dds-layer-domainparticipantfactory).
Internally it contains the following [`QosPolicy`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/core/policy/qospolicy.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds9QosPolicyE) objects:

| QosPolicy class                                                                           | Accessor/Mutator                                                                                                                                                                 | Mutable   |
|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| [EntityFactoryQosPolicy](../../core/policy/standardQosPolicies.md#entityfactoryqospolicy) | [`entity_factory()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantfactoryqos.md#_CPPv4NK8eprosima7fastdds3dds27DomainParticipantFactoryQos14entity_factoryEv)          | Yes       |
| [ThreadSettings](../../core/policy/eprosimaExtensions.md#threadsettingsqos)               | [`shm_watchdog_thread()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantfactoryqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds27DomainParticipantFactoryQos19shm_watchdog_threadEv) | No        |
| [ThreadSettings](../../core/policy/eprosimaExtensions.md#threadsettingsqos)               | [`file_watch_threads()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantfactoryqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds27DomainParticipantFactoryQos18file_watch_threadsEv)   | No        |

Since the DomainParticipantFactory is a singleton, its QoS can only be modified with the
[`DomainParticipantFactory::set_qos()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantfactory.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds24DomainParticipantFactory7set_qosERK27DomainParticipantFactoryQos) member function.

```c++
DomainParticipantFactoryQos qos;

// Setting autoenable_created_entities to true makes the created DomainParticipants
// to be enabled upon creation
qos.entity_factory().autoenable_created_entities = true;
if (DomainParticipantFactory::get_instance()->set_qos(qos) != RETCODE_OK)
{
    // Error
    return;
}

// Create a DomainParticipant with the new DomainParticipantFactoryQos.
// The returned DomainParticipant is already enabled
DomainParticipant* enabled_participant =
        DomainParticipantFactory::get_instance()->create_participant(0, PARTICIPANT_QOS_DEFAULT);
if (nullptr == enabled_participant)
{
    // Error
    return;
}

// Setting autoenable_created_entities to false makes the created DomainParticipants
// to be disabled upon creation
qos.entity_factory().autoenable_created_entities = false;
if (DomainParticipantFactory::get_instance()->set_qos(qos) != RETCODE_OK)
{
    // Error
    return;
}

// Create a DomainParticipant with the new DomainParticipantFactoryQos.
// The returned DomainParticipant is disabled and will need to be enabled explicitly
DomainParticipant* disabled_participant =
        DomainParticipantFactory::get_instance()->create_participant(0, PARTICIPANT_QOS_DEFAULT);
if (nullptr == disabled_participant)
{
    // Error
    return;
}
```

<a id="dds-layer-domainparticipantfactory-profiles"></a>

<a id="dds-layer-domainparticipantfactory-load-profiles"></a>

<a id="loading-profiles-from-an-xml-file"></a>

## Loading profiles from an XML file

To create Entities based on XML profiles, the file containing such profiles must be loaded first.

If the profile is described in one of the default loaded files, it will be automatically available on initialization.
Otherwise, [`load_XML_profiles_file()`](../../../api_reference/dds_pim/domain/domainparticipantfactory.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds24DomainParticipantFactory22load_XML_profiles_fileERKNSt6stringE) member function can be used to load the profiles in
the XML.
See section [XML profiles](../../../xml_configuration/xml_configuration.md#xml-profiles) for more information regarding XML profile format and automatic loading.

Once loaded, the name of the profiles can be used to create Entities that will have QoS settings according to
the profile specifications.

```c++
// Load the XML with the profiles
DomainParticipantFactory::get_instance()->load_XML_profiles_file("profiles.xml");

// Profiles can now be used to create Entities
DomainParticipant* participant_with_profile =
        DomainParticipantFactory::get_instance()->create_participant_with_profile(0, "participant_profile");
if (nullptr == participant_with_profile)
{
    // Error
    return;
}
```
