# OwnershipQosPolicyKind

### enum eprosima::fastdds::dds::OwnershipQosPolicyKind

Enum OwnershipQosPolicyKind, different kinds of ownership for [OwnershipQosPolicy](ownershipqospolicy.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1OwnershipQosPolicy). 

*Values:*

### enumerator SHARED_OWNERSHIP_QOS

Indicates shared ownership for each instance. Multiple writers are allowed to update the same instance and all the updates are made available to the readers. In other words there is no concept of an “owner” for the instances. 

### enumerator EXCLUSIVE_OWNERSHIP_QOS

Indicates each instance can only be owned by one [DataWriter](../../publisher/datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter), but the owner of an instance can change dynamically. The selection of the owner is controlled by the setting of the [OwnershipStrengthQosPolicy](ownershipstrengthqospolicy.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1OwnershipStrengthQosPolicy). The owner is always set to be the highest-strength [DataWriter](../../publisher/datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) object among the ones currently “active” (as determined by the [LivelinessQosPolicy](livelinessqospolicy.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1LivelinessQosPolicy)).

<!-- Source: https://fast-dds.docs.eprosima.com/en/latest/fastdds/api_reference/dds_pim/core/policy/ownershipstrengthqospolicy.md -->

<a id="api-pim-ownershipstrengthqospolicy"></a>

Specifies the value of the “strength” used to arbitrate among multiple [DataWriter](../../publisher/datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) objects that attempt to modify the same instance of a data-object (identified by [Topic](../../topic/topic_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Topic) + key).This policy only applies if the OWNERSHIP QoS policy is of kind EXCLUSIVE.

# PartitionQosPolicy

### class PartitionQosPolicy : public eprosima::fastdds::dds::Parameter_t, public eprosima::fastdds::dds::[QosPolicy](qospolicy.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds9QosPolicyE)

Set of strings that introduces a logical partition among the topics visible by the [Publisher](../../publisher/publisher_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Publisher) and [Subscriber](../../subscriber/subscriber_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Subscriber). A [DataWriter](../../publisher/datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) within a [Publisher](../../publisher/publisher_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Publisher) only communicates with a [DataReader](../../subscriber/datareader.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataReader) in a [Subscriber](../../subscriber/subscriber_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Subscriber) if (in addition to matching the [Topic](../../topic/topic_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Topic) and having compatible QoS) the [Publisher](../../publisher/publisher_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Publisher) and [Subscriber](../../subscriber/subscriber_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Subscriber) have a common partition name string.

The empty string (“”) is considered a valid partition that is matched with other partition names using the same rules of string matching and regular-expression matching used for any other partition name.

# PresentationQosPolicy

### class PresentationQosPolicy : public eprosima::fastdds::dds::Parameter_t, public eprosima::fastdds::dds::[QosPolicy](qospolicy.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds9QosPolicyE)

Specifies how the samples representing changes to data instances are presented to the subscribing application. This policy affects the application’s ability to specify and receive coherent changes and to see the relative order of changes.access_scope determines the largest scope spanning the entities for which the order and coherency of changes can be preserved. The two booleans control whether coherent access and ordered access are supported within the scope access_scope.

#### NOTE
Immutable Qos Policy 

#### WARNING
This [QosPolicy](qospolicy.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1QosPolicy) can be defined and is transmitted to the rest of the network but is not implemented in this version.

### Public Functions

### inline PresentationQosPolicy()

Constructor without parameters. 

### virtual ~PresentationQosPolicy() = default

Destructor. 

### inline virtual void clear() override

Clears the [QosPolicy](qospolicy.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1QosPolicy) object. 

### Public Members

### [PresentationQosPolicyAccessScopeKind](presentationqospolicyaccessscopekind.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds36PresentationQosPolicyAccessScopeKindE) access_scope

Access Scope Kind

By default, INSTANCE_PRESENTATION_QOS.

### bool coherent_access

Specifies support coherent access. That is, the ability to group a set of changes as a unit on the publishing end such that they are received as a unit at the subscribing end. by default, false. 

### bool ordered_access

Specifies support for ordered access to the samples received at the subscription end. That is, the ability of the subscriber to see changes in the same order as they occurred on the publishing end. By default, false.

# PresentationQosPolicyAccessScopeKind

### enum eprosima::fastdds::dds::PresentationQosPolicyAccessScopeKind

Enum PresentationQosPolicyAccessScopeKind, different kinds of Presentation Policy order for [PresentationQosPolicy](presentationqospolicy.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1PresentationQosPolicy). 

*Values:*

### enumerator INSTANCE_PRESENTATION_QOS

Scope spans only a single instance. Indicates that changes to one instance need not be coherent nor ordered with respect to changes to any other instance. In other words, order and coherent changes apply to each instance separately. 

### enumerator TOPIC_PRESENTATION_QOS

Scope spans to all instances within the same [DataWriter](../../publisher/datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) (or [DataReader](../../subscriber/datareader.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataReader)), but not across instances in different [DataWriter](../../publisher/datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) (or [DataReader](../../subscriber/datareader.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataReader)). 

### enumerator GROUP_PRESENTATION_QOS

Scope spans to all instances belonging to [DataWriter](../../publisher/datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) (or [DataReader](../../subscriber/datareader.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataReader)) entities within the same [Publisher](../../publisher/publisher_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Publisher) (or [Subscriber](../../subscriber/subscriber_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Subscriber)).

# ReliabilityQosPolicyKind

### enum eprosima::fastdds::dds::ReliabilityQosPolicyKind

Enum ReliabilityQosPolicyKind, different kinds of reliability for [ReliabilityQosPolicy](reliabilityqospolicy.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1ReliabilityQosPolicy). 

*Values:*

### enumerator BEST_EFFORT_RELIABILITY_QOS

Indicates that it is acceptable to not retry propagation of any samples. Presumably new values for the samples are generated often enough that it is not necessary to re-send or acknowledge any samples 

### enumerator RELIABLE_RELIABILITY_QOS

Specifies the Service will attempt to deliver all samples in its history. Missed samples may be retried. In steady-state (no modifications communicated via the [DataWriter](../../publisher/datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter)) the middleware guarantees that all samples in the [DataWriter](../../publisher/datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) history will eventually be delivered to all the [DataReader](../../subscriber/datareader.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataReader) objects. Outside steady state the [HistoryQosPolicy](historyqospolicy.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1HistoryQosPolicy) and [ResourceLimitsQosPolicy](resourcelimitsqospolicy.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1ResourceLimitsQosPolicy) will determine how samples become part of the history and whether samples can be discarded from it.

<!-- Source: https://fast-dds.docs.eprosima.com/en/latest/fastdds/api_reference/dds_pim/core/policy/resourcelimitsqospolicy.md -->

# ResourceLimitsQosPolicy

### class ResourceLimitsQosPolicy : public eprosima::fastdds::dds::Parameter_t, public eprosima::fastdds::dds::[QosPolicy](qospolicy.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds9QosPolicyE)

Specifies the resources that the Service can consume in order to meet the requested QoS

#### NOTE
Immutable Qos Policy 

### Public Functions

### inline ResourceLimitsQosPolicy()

Constructor. 

### virtual ~ResourceLimitsQosPolicy() = default

Destructor. 

### inline virtual void clear() override

Clears the [QosPolicy](qospolicy.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1QosPolicy) object. 

### Public Members

### std::int32_t max_samples

Specifies the maximum number of data-samples the [DataWriter](../../publisher/datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) (or [DataReader](../../subscriber/datareader.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataReader)) can manage across all the instances associated with it. Represents the maximum samples the middleware can store for any one [DataWriter](../../publisher/datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) (or [DataReader](../../subscriber/datareader.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataReader)

).

Value less or equal to 0 means infinite resources. By default, LENGTH_UNLIMITED.

#### WARNING
It is inconsistent if `max_samples < (max_instances * max_samples_per_instance)`. 

### std::int32_t max_instances

Represents the maximum number of instances [DataWriter](../../publisher/datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) (or [DataReader](../../subscriber/datareader.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataReader)

) can manage.

Value less or equal to 0 means infinite resources. By default, LENGTH_UNLIMITED.

#### WARNING
It is inconsistent if `(max_instances * max_samples_per_instance) > max_samples`. 

### std::int32_t max_samples_per_instance

Represents the maximum number of samples of any one instance a DataWriter(or DataReader) can manage.

Value less or equal to 0 means infinite resources. By default, LENGTH_UNLIMITED.

#### WARNING
It is inconsistent if `(max_instances * max_samples_per_instance) > max_samples`. 

### std::int32_t allocated_samples

Number of samples initially allocated.

By default, 100.

### std::int32_t extra_samples

Represents the extra number of samples available once the max_samples have been reached in the history. This makes it possible, for example, to loan samples even with a full history. By default, 1.

# TimeBasedFilterQosPolicy

### class TimeBasedFilterQosPolicy : public eprosima::fastdds::dds::Parameter_t, public eprosima::fastdds::dds::[QosPolicy](qospolicy.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds9QosPolicyE)

Filter that allows a [DataReader](../../subscriber/datareader.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataReader) to specify that it is interested only in (potentially) a subset of the values of the data. The filter states that the [DataReader](../../subscriber/datareader.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataReader) does not want to receive more than one value each minimum_separation, regardless of how fast the changes occur. It is inconsistent for a [DataReader](../../subscriber/datareader.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataReader) to have a minimum_separation longer than its Deadline period.

#### NOTE
Mutable Qos Policy 

#### WARNING
This [QosPolicy](qospolicy.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1QosPolicy) can be defined and is transmitted to the rest of the network but is not implemented in this version.

### Public Members

### fastdds::dds::[Duration_t](../Time_t/Duration_t.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10Duration_tE) minimum_separation

# TopicDataQosPolicy

### class TopicDataQosPolicy : public eprosima::fastdds::dds::[GenericDataQosPolicy](genericdataqospolicy.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds20GenericDataQosPolicyE)

Class derived from [GenericDataQosPolicy](genericdataqospolicy.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1GenericDataQosPolicy). 

The purpose of this QoS is to allow the application to attach additional information to the created [Topic](../../topic/topic_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Topic) such that when a remote application discovers their existence it can examine the information and use it in an application-defined way.

In combination with the listeners on the [DataReader](../../subscriber/datareader.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataReader) and [DataWriter](../../publisher/datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) as well as by means of operations such as ignore_topic,these QoS can assist an application to extend the provided QoS.

# TypeConsistencyEnforcementQosPolicy

### class TypeConsistencyEnforcementQosPolicy : public eprosima::fastdds::dds::Parameter_t, public eprosima::fastdds::dds::[QosPolicy](qospolicy.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds9QosPolicyE)

The [TypeConsistencyEnforcementQosPolicy](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1TypeConsistencyEnforcementQosPolicy) defines the rules for determining whether the type used to publish a given data stream is consistent with that used to subscribe to it. It applies to DataReaders.

#### NOTE
Immutable Qos Policy 

### Public Functions

### inline TypeConsistencyEnforcementQosPolicy()

Constructor. 

### virtual ~TypeConsistencyEnforcementQosPolicy() override = default

Destructor. 

### inline virtual void clear() override

Clears the [QosPolicy](qospolicy.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1QosPolicy) object. 

### Public Members

### [TypeConsistencyKind](typeconsistencykind.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds19TypeConsistencyKindE) m_kind

TypeConsistencyKind.

By default, ALLOW_TYPE_COERCION.

### bool m_ignore_sequence_bounds

This option controls whether sequence bounds are taken into consideration for type assignability. If the option is set to TRUE, sequence bounds (maximum lengths) are not considered as part of the type assignability. This means that a T2 sequence type with maximum length L2 would be assignable to a T1 sequence type with maximum length L1, even if L2 is greater than L1. If the option is set to false, then sequence bounds are taken into consideration for type assignability and in order for T1 to be assignable from T2 it is required that L1>= L2.

By default, true.

### bool m_ignore_string_bounds

This option controls whether string bounds are taken into consideration for type assignability. If the option is set to TRUE, string bounds (maximum lengths) are not considered as part of the type assignability. This means that a T2 string type with maximum length L2 would be assignable to a T1 string type with maximum length L1, even if L2 is greater than L1. If the option is set to false, then string bounds are taken into consideration for type assignability and in order for T1 to be assignable from T2 it is required that L1>= L2.

By default, true.

### bool m_ignore_member_names

This option controls whether member names are taken into consideration for type assignability. If the option is set to TRUE, member names are considered as part of assignability in addition to member IDs (so that members with the same ID also have the same name). If the option is set to FALSE, then member names are not ignored.

By default, false.

### bool m_prevent_type_widening

This option controls whether type widening is allowed. If the option is set to FALSE, type widening is permitted. If the option is set to TRUE,it shall cause a wider type to not be assignable to a narrower type.

By default, false.

### bool m_force_type_validation

This option requires type information to be available in order to complete matching between a [DataWriter](../../publisher/datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) and [DataReader](../../subscriber/datareader.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataReader)

when set to TRUE, otherwise matching can occur without complete type information when set to FALSE.

By default, false.

<!-- Source: https://fast-dds.docs.eprosima.com/en/latest/fastdds/api_reference/dds_pim/core/policy/typeconsistencykind.md -->

<a id="api-pim-typeconsistencykind"></a>

<a id="typeconsistencykind"></a>

# TypeConsistencyKind

### enum eprosima::fastdds::dds::TypeConsistencyKind

*Values:*

### enumerator DISALLOW_TYPE_COERCION

The [DataWriter](../../publisher/datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) and the [DataReader](../../subscriber/datareader.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataReader) must support the same data type in order for them to communicate. 

### enumerator ALLOW_TYPE_COERCION

The [DataWriter](../../publisher/datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) and the [DataReader](../../subscriber/datareader.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataReader) need not support the same data type in order for them to communicate as long as the reader’s type is assignable from the writer’s type.

# UserDataQosPolicy

### class UserDataQosPolicy : public eprosima::fastdds::dds::[GenericDataQosPolicy](genericdataqospolicy.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds20GenericDataQosPolicyE)

Class derived from [GenericDataQosPolicy](genericdataqospolicy.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1GenericDataQosPolicy). 

The purpose of this QoS is to allow the application to attach additional information to the created [Entity](../entity.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Entity) objects such that when a remote application discovers their existence it can access that information and use it for its own purposes.

One possible use of this QoS is to attach security credentials or some other information that can be used by the remote application to authenticate the source.

# LivelinessChangedStatus

### struct LivelinessChangedStatus

A struct storing the liveliness changed status. 

### Public Members

### std::int32_t alive_count = 0

The total number of currently active publishers that write the topic read by the subscriber. 

This count increases when a newly matched publisher asserts its liveliness for the first time or when a publisher previously considered to be not alive reasserts its liveliness. The count decreases when a publisher considered alive fails to assert its liveliness and becomes not alive, whether because it was deleted normally or for some other reason 

### std::int32_t not_alive_count = 0

The total count of current publishers that write the topic read by the subscriber that are no longer asserting their liveliness. 

This count increases when a publisher considered alive fails to assert its liveliness and becomes not alive for some reason other than the normal deletion of that publisher. It decreases when a previously not alive publisher either reasserts its liveliness or is deleted normally 

### std::int32_t alive_count_change = 0

The change in the alive_count since the last time the listener was called or the status was read. 

### std::int32_t not_alive_count_change = 0

The change in the not_alive_count since the last time the listener was called or the status was read. 

### InstanceHandle_t last_publication_handle

Handle to the last publisher whose change in liveliness caused this status to change.

# StatusMask

### class StatusMask : public std::bitset<FASTDDS_STATUS_COUNT>

[StatusMask](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1StatusMask) is a bitmap or bitset field. 

This bitset is used to:
* determine which listener functions to call
* set conditions in dds::core::cond::StatusCondition
* indicate status changes when calling dds::core::Entity::status_changes 

### Public Types

### typedef std::bitset<FASTDDS_STATUS_COUNT> MaskType

Convenience typedef for std::bitset<FASTDDS_STATUS_COUNT>. 

### Public Functions

* **Parameters:**
  **mask** – the bit array to initialize the bitset with

Add given [StatusMask](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1StatusMask) bits into this [StatusMask](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1StatusMask) bitset.

* **Returns:**
  [StatusMask](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1StatusMask) this

* **Returns:**
  [StatusMask](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1StatusMask) this

  * **listener** – New value for the [DomainParticipantListener](domainparticipantlistener.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DomainParticipantListener)
  * **mask** – [StatusMask](../core/status/statusmask.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1StatusMask) that holds statuses the listener responds to 
  * **timeout** – Maximum time to wait for executing callbacks to finish. 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_OK if successful, RETCODE_ERROR if failed (timeout expired) 

### ReturnCode_t set_congestion_control_listener(fastdds::rtps::CongestionControlListener \*listener)

 **[Pro]**  Sets the listener that observes congestion-control meta-information.

Congestion control is participant-scoped (one controller per participant covering all reliable writers, evaluated per remote reader). The listener is purely observational and does not change congestion-control behavior; it only takes effect when congestion control is enabled through the participant’s properties.

#### WARNING
The listener object must outlive the participant; it is not copied. 

* **Parameters:**
  **listener** – New congestion-control listener, or nullptr to detach. 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_OK if successful.

### virtual ReturnCode_t enable() override

This operation enables the [DomainParticipant](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DomainParticipant). 

* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_OK

### [ContentFilteredTopic](../topic/contentfilteredtopic.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds20ContentFilteredTopicE) \*create_contentfilteredtopic(const std::string &name, [Topic](../topic/topic_class.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds5TopicE) \*related_topic, const std::string &filter_expression, const std::vector<std::string> &expression_parameters, ReturnCode_t &ret_code)

Create a [ContentFilteredTopic](../topic/contentfilteredtopic.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1ContentFilteredTopic) in this Participant.

* **Parameters:**
  * **name** – Name of the [ContentFilteredTopic](../topic/contentfilteredtopic.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1ContentFilteredTopic)
  * **related_topic** – Related [Topic](../topic/topic_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Topic) to being subscribed 
  * **filter_expression** – Logic expression to create filter 
  * **expression_parameters** – Parameters to filter content 
  * **ret_code** – **[out]** Return code of the operation, RETCODE_OK if the [ContentFilteredTopic](../topic/contentfilteredtopic.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1ContentFilteredTopic) is created, RETCODE_ERROR otherwise.

  Pointer to the created [ContentFilteredTopic](../topic/contentfilteredtopic.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1ContentFilteredTopic). 
* **Returns:**
  nullptr if `related_topic` does not belong to this participant. 
* **Returns:**
  nullptr if a topic with the specified `name` has already been created. 
* **Returns:**
  nullptr if a filter cannot be created with the specified `filter_expression` and `expression_parameters`.

### [Topic](../topic/topic_class.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds5TopicE) \*find_topic(const std::string &topic_name, const fastdds::dds::[Duration_t](../core/Time_t/Duration_t.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10Duration_tE) &timeout)

Gives access to an existing (or ready to exist) enabled [Topic](../topic/topic_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Topic). It should be noted that the returned [Topic](../topic/topic_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Topic) is a local object that acts as a proxy to designate the global concept of topic. Topics obtained by means of find_topic, must also be deleted by means of delete_topic so that the local resources can be released. If a [Topic](../topic/topic_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Topic) is obtained multiple times by means of find_topic or create_topic, it must also be deleted that same number of times using delete_topic.

* **Parameters:**
  * **topic_name** – [Topic](../topic/topic_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Topic) name 
  * **timeout** – Maximum time to wait for the [Topic](../topic/topic_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Topic)
* **Returns:**
  Pointer to the existing [Topic](../topic/topic_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Topic), nullptr in case of error or timeout

### ReturnCode_t assert_liveliness()

This operation manually asserts the liveliness of the [DomainParticipant](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DomainParticipant). This is used in combination with the LIVELINESS QoS policy to indicate to the Service that the entity remains active.

This operation needs to only be used if the [DomainParticipant](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DomainParticipant) contains [DataWriter](../publisher/datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) entities with the LIVELINESS set to MANUAL_BY_PARTICIPANT and it only affects the liveliness of those [DataWriter](../publisher/datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) entities. Otherwise, it has no effect.

#### NOTE
Writing data via the write operation on a [DataWriter](../publisher/datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) asserts liveliness on the [DataWriter](../publisher/datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) itself and its [DomainParticipant](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DomainParticipant). Consequently the use of assert_liveliness is only needed if the application is not writing data regularly.

* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_OK if the liveliness was asserted, RETCODE_ERROR otherwise. 

### ReturnCode_t set_default_publisher_qos(const [PublisherQos](../publisher/publisherqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds12PublisherQosE) &qos)

This operation sets a default value of the [Publisher](../publisher/publisher_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Publisher) QoS policies which will be used for newly created [Publisher](../publisher/publisher_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Publisher) entities in the case where the QoS policies are defaulted in the create_publisher operation.

This operation will check that the resulting policies are self consistent; if they are not, the operation will have no effect and return false.

The special value PUBLISHER_QOS_DEFAULT may be passed to this operation to indicate that the default QoS should be reset back to the initial values the factory would use, that is the values that would be used if the set_default_publisher_qos operation had never been called.

* **Parameters:**
  **qos** – [PublisherQos](../publisher/publisherqos.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1PublisherQos) to be set 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_INCONSISTENT_POLICY if the Qos is not self consistent and RETCODE_OK if the qos is changed correctly. 

### const [PublisherQos](../publisher/publisherqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds12PublisherQosE) &get_default_publisher_qos() const

This operation retrieves the default value of the [Publisher](../publisher/publisher_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Publisher) QoS, that is, the QoS policies which will be used for newly created [Publisher](../publisher/publisher_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Publisher) entities in the case where the QoS policies are defaulted in the create_publisher operation.

The values retrieved get_default_publisher_qos will match the set of values specified on the last successful call to set_default_publisher_qos, or else, if the call was never made, the default values.

* **Returns:**
  Current default publisher qos.

This operation retrieves the default value of the [Publisher](../publisher/publisher_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Publisher) QoS, that is, the QoS policies which will be used for newly created [Publisher](../publisher/publisher_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Publisher) entities in the case where the QoS policies are defaulted in the create_publisher operation.

* **Parameters:**

  RETCODE_INCONSISTENT_POLICY if the Qos is not self consistent and RETCODE_OK if the qos is changed correctly. 

### const [SubscriberQos](../subscriber/subscriberqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds13SubscriberQosE) &get_default_subscriber_qos() const

This operation retrieves the default value of the [Subscriber](../subscriber/subscriber_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Subscriber) QoS, that is, the QoS policies which will be used for newly created [Subscriber](../subscriber/subscriber_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Subscriber) entities in the case where the QoS policies are defaulted in the create_subscriber operation.

The values retrieved get_default_subscriber_qos will match the set of values specified on the last successful call to set_default_subscriber_qos, or else, if the call was never made, the default values.

* **Returns:**
  Current default subscriber qos.

### ReturnCode_t set_default_topic_qos(const [TopicQos](../topic/topicqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds8TopicQosE) &qos)

This operation sets a default value of the [Topic](../topic/topic_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Topic) QoS policies which will be used for newly created [Topic](../topic/topic_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Topic) entities in the case where the QoS policies are defaulted in the create_topic operation.

This operation will check that the resulting policies are self consistent; if they are not, the operation will have no effect and return INCONSISTENT_POLICY.

The special value TOPIC_QOS_DEFAULT may be passed to this operation to indicate that the default QoS should be reset back to the initial values the factory would use, that is the values that would be used if the set_default_topic_qos operation had never been called.

* **Parameters:**
  **qos** – [TopicQos](../topic/topicqos.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1TopicQos) to be set 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_INCONSISTENT_POLICY if the Qos is not self consistent and RETCODE_OK if the qos is changed correctly. 

### const [TopicQos](../topic/topicqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds8TopicQosE) &get_default_topic_qos() const

This operation retrieves the default value of the [Topic](../topic/topic_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Topic) QoS, that is, the QoS policies that will be used for newly created [Topic](../topic/topic_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Topic) entities in the case where the QoS policies are defaulted in the create_topic operation.

The values retrieved get_default_topic_qos will match the set of values specified on the last successful call to set_default_topic_qos, or else, TOPIC_QOS_DEFAULT if the call was never made.

* **Returns:**
  Current default topic qos.

### bool contains_entity(const InstanceHandle_t &a_handle, bool recursive = true) const

This operation checks whether or not the given handle represents an [Entity](../core/entity.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Entity) that was created from the [DomainParticipant](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DomainParticipant).

* **Parameters:**
  * **a_handle** – InstanceHandle of the entity to look for. 
  * **recursive** – The containment applies recursively. That is, it applies both to entities ([TopicDescription](../topic/topicdescription.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1TopicDescription), [Publisher](../publisher/publisher_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Publisher), or [Subscriber](../subscriber/subscriber_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Subscriber)) created directly using the [DomainParticipant](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DomainParticipant) as well as entities created using a contained [Publisher](../publisher/publisher_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Publisher), or [Subscriber](../subscriber/subscriber_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Subscriber) as the factory, and so forth. (default: true) 
* **Returns:**
  True if entity is contained. False otherwise.

### ReturnCode_t register_content_filter_factory(const char \*filter_class_name, [IContentFilterFactory](../topic/icontentfilterfactory.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds21IContentFilterFactoryE) \*const filter_factory)

Register a custom content filter factory, which can be used to create a [ContentFilteredTopic](../topic/contentfilteredtopic.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1ContentFilteredTopic).

DDS specifies a SQL-like content filter to be used by content filtered topics. If this filter does not meet your filtering requirements, you can register a custom filter factory.

To use a custom filter, a factory for it must be registered in the following places:

* In any application that uses the custom filter factory to create a [ContentFilteredTopic](../topic/contentfilteredtopic.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1ContentFilteredTopic) and the corresponding [DataReader](../subscriber/datareader.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataReader).
* In each application that writes the data to the applications mentioned above.

For example, suppose Application A on the subscription side creates a [Topic](../topic/topic_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Topic) named X and a [ContentFilteredTopic](../topic/contentfilteredtopic.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1ContentFilteredTopic) named filteredX (and a corresponding [DataReader](../subscriber/datareader.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataReader)), using a previously registered content filter factory, myFilterFactory. With only that, you will have filtering at the subscription side. If you also want to perform filtering in any application that publishes [Topic](../topic/topic_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Topic) X, then you also need to register the same definition of the ContentFilterFactory myFilterFactory in that application.

Each `filter_class_name` can only be used to register a content filter factory once per [DomainParticipant](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DomainParticipant).

* **Parameters:**
  * **filter_class_name** – Name of the filter class. Cannot be nullptr, must not exceed 255 characters, and must be unique within this [DomainParticipant](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DomainParticipant). 
  * **filter_factory** – Factory of content filters to be registered. Cannot be nullptr.
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_BAD_PARAMETER if any parameter is nullptr, or the filter_class_name exceeds 255 characters. 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_PRECONDITION_NOT_MET if the filter_class_name has been already registered. 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_PRECONDITION_NOT_MET if filter_class_name is FASTDDS_SQLFILTER_NAME. 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_OK if the filter is correctly registered. 

### [IContentFilterFactory](../topic/icontentfilterfactory.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds21IContentFilterFactoryE) \*lookup_content_filter_factory(const char \*filter_class_name)

Lookup a custom content filter factory previously registered with register_content_filter_factory.

* **Parameters:**
  **filter_class_name** – Name of the filter class. Cannot be nullptr.
* **Returns:**
  nullptr if the given filter_class_name has not been previously registered on this [DomainParticipant](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DomainParticipant). Otherwise, the content filter factory previously registered with the given filter_class_name. 

### ReturnCode_t unregister_content_filter_factory(const char \*filter_class_name)

Unregister a custom content filter factory previously registered with register_content_filter_factory.

A filter_class_name can be unregistered only if it has been previously registered to the [DomainParticipant](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DomainParticipant) with register_content_filter_factory.

The unregistration of filter is not allowed if there are any existing [ContentFilteredTopic](../topic/contentfilteredtopic.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1ContentFilteredTopic) objects that are using the filter.

If there is any existing discovered [DataReader](../subscriber/datareader.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataReader) with the same filter_class_name, filtering on the writer side will be stopped, but this operation will not fail.

* **Parameters:**
  **filter_class_name** – Name of the filter class. Cannot be nullptr.
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_BAD_PARAMETER if the filter_class_name is nullptr. 
* **Returns:**
  RERCODE_PRECONDITION_NOT_MET if the filter_class_name has not been previously registered. 
* **Returns:**
  RERCODE_PRECONDITION_NOT_MET if there is any [ContentFilteredTopic](../topic/contentfilteredtopic.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1ContentFilteredTopic) referencing the filter. 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_OK if the filter is correctly unregistered. 

### bool has_active_entities()

Check if the Participant has any [Publisher](../publisher/publisher_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Publisher), [Subscriber](../subscriber/subscriber_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Subscriber) or [Topic](../topic/topic_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Topic) created by the user. 

The entities that the statistics module creates for itself are not taken into account, since they do not keep the Participant from being deleted.

* **Returns:**
  true if any, false otherwise.

### [DomainParticipant](domainparticipant.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds17DomainParticipantE) \*lookup_participant(DomainId_t domain_id) const

This operation retrieves a previously created [DomainParticipant](domainparticipant.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DomainParticipant) belonging to specified domain_id. If no such [DomainParticipant](domainparticipant.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DomainParticipant) exists, the operation will return ‘nullptr’. If multiple [DomainParticipant](domainparticipant.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DomainParticipant) entities belonging to that domain_id exist, then the operation will return one of them. It is not specified which one.

* **Parameters:**
  **domain_id** – 
* **Returns:**
  previously created [DomainParticipant](domainparticipant.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DomainParticipant) within the specified domain

### ReturnCode_t get_default_participant_qos([DomainParticipantQos](domainparticipantqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds20DomainParticipantQosE) &qos) const

This operation retrieves the default value of the [DomainParticipant](domainparticipant.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DomainParticipant) QoS, that is, the QoS policies which will be used for newly created [DomainParticipant](domainparticipant.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DomainParticipant) entities in the case where the QoS policies are defaulted in the create_participant operation. The values retrieved get_default_participant_qos will match the set of values specified on the last successful call to set_default_participant_qos, or else, if the call was never made, the default values. 

* **Parameters:**
  **qos** – [DomainParticipantQos](domainparticipantqos.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DomainParticipantQos) where the qos is returned 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_OK 

### const [DomainParticipantQos](domainparticipantqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds20DomainParticipantQosE) &get_default_participant_qos() const

This operation retrieves the default value of the [DomainParticipant](domainparticipant.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DomainParticipant) QoS, that is, the QoS policies which will be used for newly created [DomainParticipant](domainparticipant.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DomainParticipant) entities in the case where the QoS policies are defaulted in the create_participant operation. The values retrieved get_default_participant_qos will match the set of values specified on the last successful call to set_default_participant_qos, or else, if the call was never made, the default values. 

* **Returns:**
  A reference to the default [DomainParticipantQos](domainparticipantqos.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DomainParticipantQos)

### ReturnCode_t set_default_participant_qos(const [DomainParticipantQos](domainparticipantqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds20DomainParticipantQosE) &qos)

This operation sets a default value of the [DomainParticipant](domainparticipant.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DomainParticipant) QoS policies which will be used for newly created [DomainParticipant](domainparticipant.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DomainParticipant) entities in the case where the QoS policies are defaulted in the create_participant operation. 

This operation will check that the resulting policies are self consistent; if they are not, the operation will have no effect and return INCONSISTENT_POLICY.

The special value PARTICIPANT_QOS_DEFAULT may be passed to this operation to indicate that the default QoS should be reset back to the initial values the factory would use, that is the values that would be used if the set_default_participant_qos operation had never been called.

* **Parameters:**
  **qos** – [DomainParticipantQos](domainparticipantqos.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DomainParticipantQos) to be set 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_INCONSISTENT_POLICY if the Qos is not self consistent and RETCODE_OK if the qos is changed correctly.

### ReturnCode_t set_qos(const [DomainParticipantFactoryQos](domainparticipantfactoryqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds27DomainParticipantFactoryQosE) &qos)

This operation sets the value of the [DomainParticipantFactory](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DomainParticipantFactory) QoS policies. These policies control the behavior of the object a factory for entities.

Note that despite having QoS, the [DomainParticipantFactory](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DomainParticipantFactory) is not an [Entity](../core/entity.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Entity).

This operation will check that the resulting policies are self consistent; if they are not, the operation will have no effect and return INCONSISTENT_POLICY.

* **Parameters:**
  **qos** – [DomainParticipantFactoryQos](domainparticipantfactoryqos.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DomainParticipantFactoryQos) to be set. 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_IMMUTABLE_POLICY if any of the Qos cannot be changed, RETCODE_INCONSISTENT_POLICY if the Qos is not self consistent and RETCODE_OK if the qos is changed correctly.

### inline virtual void on_data_reader_discovery([DomainParticipant](domainparticipant.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds17DomainParticipantE) \*participant, rtps::[ReaderDiscoveryStatus](../../rtps/participant/participantdiscoveryinfo/ReaderDiscoveryStatus.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds4rtps21ReaderDiscoveryStatusE) reason, const SubscriptionBuiltinTopicData &info, bool &should_be_ignored)

This method is called when a new [DataReader](../subscriber/datareader.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataReader) is discovered, or a previously discovered [DataReader](../subscriber/datareader.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataReader) changes its QOS or is removed.

  * **participant** – **[in]** Pointer to the Participant which discovered the remote reader. 
  * **reason** – **[in]** The reason motivating this method to be called. 
  * **info** – **[in]** Remote reader information. 
  * **should_be_ignored** – **[out]** Flag to indicate the library to automatically ignore the discovered reader. 

### inline virtual void on_data_writer_discovery([DomainParticipant](domainparticipant.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds17DomainParticipantE) \*participant, rtps::[WriterDiscoveryStatus](../../rtps/participant/participantdiscoveryinfo/WriterDiscoveryStatus.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds4rtps21WriterDiscoveryStatusE) reason, const PublicationBuiltinTopicData &info, bool &should_be_ignored)

This method is called when a new [DataWriter](../publisher/datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) is discovered, or a previously discovered [DataWriter](../publisher/datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) changes its QOS or is removed. 

* **Parameters:**
  * **participant** – **[in]** Pointer to the Participant which discovered the remote writer. 
  * **reason** – **[in]** The reason motivating this method to be called. 
  * **info** – **[in]** Remote writer information. 
  * **should_be_ignored** – **[out]** Flag to indicate the library to automatically ignore the discovered writer. 

### inline virtual bool should_endpoints_match(const [DomainParticipant](domainparticipant.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds17DomainParticipantE) \*participant, const SubscriptionBuiltinTopicData &reader_info, const PublicationBuiltinTopicData &writer_info)

This method is called to check whether a discovered [DataReader](../subscriber/datareader.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataReader) and [DataWriter](../publisher/datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) should be matched or not. It is called after successful validation of the standard DDS matching rules. By default, they will match, but the user can override this method to implement custom matching logic.

* **Parameters:**
  * **participant** – **[in]** Pointer to the Participant which discovered the remote endpoints. 
  * **reader_info** – **[in]** Remote reader information. 
  * **writer_info** – **[in]** Remote writer information.
* **Returns:**
  true if the endpoints should be matched, false otherwise.

# DataWriter

### class DataWriter : public eprosima::fastdds::dds::[DomainEntity](../core/domainentity.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds12DomainEntityE)

Class [DataWriter](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter), contains the actual implementation of the behaviour of the [DataWriter](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter). 

### Public Types

### enum class LoanInitializationKind

How to initialize samples loaned with [loan_sample](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter_1aad64a30e5d44ab10acffc543e6dc9cb3)

*Values:*

### enumerator NO_LOAN_INITIALIZATION

Do not perform initialization of sample. 

This is the default initialization scheme of loaned samples. It is the fastest scheme, but implies the user should take care of writing every field on the data type before calling [write](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter_1a8e44c93541265fd4a049bf2e72838cc6) on the loaned sample. 

### enumerator ZERO_LOAN_INITIALIZATION

Initialize all memory with zero-valued bytes. 

The contents of the loaned sample will be zero-initialized upon return of [loan_sample](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter_1aad64a30e5d44ab10acffc543e6dc9cb3). 

### enumerator CONSTRUCTED_LOAN_INITIALIZATION

Use in-place constructor initialization. 

This will call the constructor of the data type over the memory space being returned by [loan_sample](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter_1aad64a30e5d44ab10acffc543e6dc9cb3). 

### Public Functions

### virtual ReturnCode_t enable() override

This operation enables the [DataWriter](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter). 

* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_OK is successfully enabled. RETCODE_PRECONDITION_NOT_MET if the [Publisher](publisher_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Publisher) creating this [DataWriter](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) is not enabled. 

### ReturnCode_t write(const void \*const data)

Write data to the topic.

* **Parameters:**
  **data** – Pointer to the data 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_OK if the data is correctly sent or a ReturnCode related to the specific error otherwise. 

### ReturnCode_t write(const void \*const data, fastdds::rtps::[WriteParams](../../rtps/common/WriteParams/WriteParams.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds4rtps11WriteParamsE) &params)

Write data with params to the topic.

* **Parameters:**
  * **data** – Pointer to the data 
  * **params** – Extra write parameters. 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_OK if the data is correctly sent or a ReturnCode related to the specific error otherwise. 

### ReturnCode_t write(const void \*const data, const InstanceHandle_t &handle)

Write data with handle.

The special value HANDLE_NIL can be used for the parameter handle.This indicates that the identity of the instance should be automatically deduced from the instance_data (by means of the key).

* **Parameters:**
  * **data** – Pointer to the data 
  * **handle** – InstanceHandle_t. 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_PRECONDITION_NOT_MET if the handle introduced does not match with the one associated to the data, RETCODE_OK if the data is correctly sent and RETCODE_ERROR otherwise. 

### ReturnCode_t write_w_timestamp(const void \*const data, const InstanceHandle_t &handle, const fastdds::dds::[Time_t](../core/Time_t/Time_t.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds6Time_tE) &timestamp)

This operation performs the same function as write except that it also provides the value for the [source_timestamp](../subscriber/sampleinfo.md#structeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1SampleInfo_1aa71276d2e848778a63868f8c3ac3a1b7) that is made available to [DataReader](../subscriber/datareader.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataReader) objects by means of the [eprosima::fastdds::dds::SampleInfo::source_timestamp](../subscriber/sampleinfo.md#structeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1SampleInfo_1aa71276d2e848778a63868f8c3ac3a1b7) attribute “source_timestamp” inside the [SampleInfo](../subscriber/sampleinfo.md#structeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1SampleInfo). The constraints on the values of the `handle` parameter and the corresponding error behavior are the same specified for the [write](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter_1a8e44c93541265fd4a049bf2e72838cc6) operation. This operation may block and return RETCODE_TIMEOUT under the same circumstances described for the [write](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter_1a8e44c93541265fd4a049bf2e72838cc6) operation. This operation may return RETCODE_OUT_OF_RESOURCES, RETCODE_PRECONDITION_NOT_MET or RETCODE_BAD_PARAMETER under the same circumstances described for the write operation. 

* **Parameters:**
  * **data** – Pointer to the data 
  * **handle** – InstanceHandle_t 
  * **timestamp** – [Time_t](../core/Time_t/Time_t.md#structeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Time__t) used to set the source_timestamp. 
* **Returns:**
  Any of the standard return codes. 

### InstanceHandle_t register_instance(const void \*const instance)

Informs that the application will be modifying a particular instance. 

It gives an opportunity to the middleware to pre-configure itself to improve performance.

* **Parameters:**
  **instance** – **[in]** Sample used to get the instance’s key. 
* **Returns:**
  Handle containing the instance’s key. This handle could be used in successive `write` or `dispose` operations. In case of error, HANDLE_NIL will be returned. 

### InstanceHandle_t register_instance_w_timestamp(const void \*const instance, const fastdds::dds::[Time_t](../core/Time_t/Time_t.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds6Time_tE) &timestamp)

This operation performs the same function as register_instance and can be used instead of [register_instance](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter_1a8464aa9cc60c2a53f9ea85f45f3b5069) in the cases where the application desires to specify the value for the [source_timestamp](../subscriber/sampleinfo.md#structeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1SampleInfo_1aa71276d2e848778a63868f8c3ac3a1b7). The [source_timestamp](../subscriber/sampleinfo.md#structeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1SampleInfo_1aa71276d2e848778a63868f8c3ac3a1b7) potentially affects the relative order in which readers observe events from multiple writers. See the QoS policy [DESTINATION_ORDER](datawriterqos.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriterQos_1ad0bbec867eb388e8543e37251becf43c). 

This operation may block and return RETCODE_TIMEOUT under the same circumstances described for the [write](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter_1a8e44c93541265fd4a049bf2e72838cc6) operation.

This operation may return RETCODE_OUT_OF_RESOURCES under the same circumstances described for the [write](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter_1a8e44c93541265fd4a049bf2e72838cc6) operation.

* **Parameters:**
  * **instance** – Sample used to get the instance’s key. 
  * **timestamp** – [Time_t](../core/Time_t/Time_t.md#structeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Time__t) used to set the source_timestamp. 
* **Returns:**
  Handle containing the instance’s key. 

### ReturnCode_t unregister_instance(const void \*const instance, const InstanceHandle_t &handle)

This operation reverses the action of `register_instance`. 

It should only be called on an instance that is currently registered. Informs the middleware that the [DataWriter](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) is not intending to modify any more of that data instance. Also indicates that the middleware can locally remove all information regarding that instance.

* **Parameters:**
  * **instance** – **[in]** Sample used to deduce instance’s key in case of `handle` parameter is HANDLE_NIL. 
  * **handle** – **[in]** Instance’s key to be unregistered. 
* **Returns:**
  Returns the operation’s result. If the operation finishes successfully, RETCODE_OK is returned. 

### ReturnCode_t unregister_instance_w_timestamp(const void \*const instance, const InstanceHandle_t &handle, const fastdds::dds::[Time_t](../core/Time_t/Time_t.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds6Time_tE) &timestamp)

This operation performs the same function as [unregister_instance](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter_1acf1b46d769f807c1258565c2a4f34abe) and can be used instead of [unregister_instance](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter_1acf1b46d769f807c1258565c2a4f34abe) in the cases where the application desires to specify the value for the [source_timestamp](../subscriber/sampleinfo.md#structeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1SampleInfo_1aa71276d2e848778a63868f8c3ac3a1b7). The [source_timestamp](../subscriber/sampleinfo.md#structeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1SampleInfo_1aa71276d2e848778a63868f8c3ac3a1b7) potentially affects the relative order in which readers observe events from multiple writers. See the QoS policy [DESTINATION_ORDER](datawriterqos.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriterQos_1ad0bbec867eb388e8543e37251becf43c). 

The constraints on the values of the `handle` parameter and the corresponding error behavior are the same specified for the [unregister_instance](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter_1acf1b46d769f807c1258565c2a4f34abe) operation.

This operation may block and return RETCODE_TIMEOUT under the same circumstances described for the write operation

* **Parameters:**
  * **instance** – Sample used to deduce instance’s key in case of `handle` parameter is HANDLE_NIL. 
  * **handle** – Instance’s key to be unregistered. 
  * **timestamp** – [Time_t](../core/Time_t/Time_t.md#structeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Time__t) used to set the source_timestamp. 
* **Returns:**
  Handle containing the instance’s key. 

### ReturnCode_t get_key_value(void \*key_holder, const InstanceHandle_t &handle)

This operation can be used to retrieve the instance key that corresponds to an instance_handle. The operation will only fill the fields that form the key inside the key_holder instance.

This operation may return BAD_PARAMETER if the InstanceHandle_t handle does not correspond to an existing data-object known to the [DataWriter](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter). If the implementation is not able to check invalid handles then the result in this situation is unspecified.

* **Parameters:**
  * **key_holder** – **[inout]** Sample where the key fields will be returned. 
  * **handle** – **[in]** Handle to the instance to retrieve the key values from.
* **Returns:**
  Any of the standard return codes.

### ReturnCode_t dispose(const void \*const data, const InstanceHandle_t &handle)

This operation requests the middleware to delete the data (the actual deletion is postponed until there is no more use for that data in the whole system). In general, applications are made aware of the deletion by means of operations on the [DataReader](../subscriber/datareader.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataReader) objects that already knew that instance. This operation does not modify the value of the instance. The instance parameter is passed just for the purposes of identifying the instance. When this operation is used, the Service will automatically supply the value of the source_timestamp that is made available to [DataReader](../subscriber/datareader.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataReader) objects by means of the source_timestamp attribute inside the [SampleInfo](../subscriber/sampleinfo.md#structeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1SampleInfo). The constraints on the values of the handle parameter and the corresponding error behavior are the same specified for the unregister_instance operation. 

* **Parameters:**
  * **data** – **[in]** Sample used to deduce instance’s key in case of `handle` parameter is HANDLE_NIL. 
  * **handle** – **[in]** InstanceHandle of the data 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_PRECONDITION_NOT_MET if the handle introduced does not match with the one associated to the data, RETCODE_OK if the data is correctly sent and RETCODE_ERROR otherwise. 

### ReturnCode_t dispose_w_timestamp(const void \*const instance, const InstanceHandle_t &handle, const fastdds::dds::[Time_t](../core/Time_t/Time_t.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds6Time_tE) &timestamp)

This operation performs the same functions as [dispose](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter_1abb86bfcc5db5016533c00055e9a28d5e) except that the application provides the value for the [source_timestamp](../subscriber/sampleinfo.md#structeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1SampleInfo_1aa71276d2e848778a63868f8c3ac3a1b7) that is made available to [DataReader](../subscriber/datareader.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataReader) objects by means of the [source_timestamp](../subscriber/sampleinfo.md#structeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1SampleInfo_1aa71276d2e848778a63868f8c3ac3a1b7) attribute inside the [SampleInfo](../subscriber/sampleinfo.md#structeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1SampleInfo). 

The constraints on the values of the `handle` parameter and the corresponding error behavior are the same specified for the [dispose](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter_1abb86bfcc5db5016533c00055e9a28d5e) operation.

This operation may return RETCODE_PRECONDITION_NOT_MET and RETCODE_BAD_PARAMETER under the same circumstances described for the [dispose](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter_1abb86bfcc5db5016533c00055e9a28d5e) operation.

This operation may return RETCODE_TIMEOUT and RETCODE_OUT_OF_RESOURCES under the same circumstances described for the [write](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter_1a8e44c93541265fd4a049bf2e72838cc6) operation.

* **Parameters:**
  * **instance** – Sample used to deduce instance’s key in case of `handle` parameter is HANDLE_NIL. 
  * **handle** – Instance’s key to be disposed. 
  * **timestamp** – [Time_t](../core/Time_t/Time_t.md#structeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Time__t) used to set the source_timestamp. 
* **Returns:**
  FASTDDS_EXPORTED_API

### ReturnCode_t assert_liveliness()

This operation manually asserts the liveliness of the [DataWriter](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter). This is used in combination with the [LivelinessQosPolicy](../core/policy/livelinessqospolicy.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1LivelinessQosPolicy) to indicate to the Service that the entity remains active. This operation need only be used if the LIVELINESS setting is either MANUAL_BY_PARTICIPANT or MANUAL_BY_TOPIC. Otherwise, it has no effect. 

#### NOTE
Writing data via the write operation on a [DataWriter](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) asserts liveliness on the [DataWriter](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) itself and its [DomainParticipant](../domain/domainparticipant.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DomainParticipant). Consequently the use of assert_liveliness is only needed if the application is not writing data regularly.

* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_OK if asserted, RETCODE_ERROR otherwise

### ReturnCode_t loan_sample(void \*&sample, [LoanInitializationKind](#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10DataWriter22LoanInitializationKindE) initialization = [LoanInitializationKind](#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10DataWriter22LoanInitializationKindE)::[NO_LOAN_INITIALIZATION](#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10DataWriter22LoanInitializationKind22NO_LOAN_INITIALIZATIONE))

Get a pointer to the internal pool where the user could directly write. 

This method can only be used on a [DataWriter](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) for a plain data type. It will provide the user with a pointer to an internal buffer where the data type can be prepared for sending.

When using NO_LOAN_INITIALIZATION on the initialization parameter, which is the default, no assumptions should be made on the contents where the pointer points to, as it may be an old pointer being reused. See [LoanInitializationKind](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter_1a880a5d5c543b72f75a43f67e1ffdea50) for more details.

Once the sample has been prepared, it can then be published by calling [write](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter_1a8e44c93541265fd4a049bf2e72838cc6). After a successful call to [write](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter_1a8e44c93541265fd4a049bf2e72838cc6), the middleware takes ownership of the loaned pointer again, and the user should not access that memory again.

If, for whatever reason, the sample is not published, the loan can be returned by calling [discard_loan](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter_1ad754c7900c37468e0c038c12a23c70f2).

* **Parameters:**
  * **sample** – **[out]** Pointer to the sample on the internal pool. 
  * **initialization** – **[in]** How to initialize the loaned sample.
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_ILLEGAL_OPERATION when the data type does not support loans. 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_NOT_ENABLED if the writer has not been enabled. 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_OUT_OF_RESOURCES if the pool has been exhausted. 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_OK if a pointer to a sample is successfully obtained. 

### ReturnCode_t discard_loan(void \*&sample)

Discards a loaned sample pointer. 

See the description on [loan_sample](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter_1aad64a30e5d44ab10acffc543e6dc9cb3) for how and when to call this method.

* **Parameters:**
  **sample** – **[inout]** Pointer to the previously loaned sample.
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_ILLEGAL_OPERATION when the data type does not support loans. 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_NOT_ENABLED if the writer has not been enabled. 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_BAD_PARAMETER if the pointer does not correspond to a loaned sample. 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_OK if the loan is successfully discarded. 

### ReturnCode_t get_sending_locators(rtps::[LocatorList](../../rtps/common/Locator/LocatorList.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds4rtps11LocatorListE) &locators) const

Get the list of locators from which this [DataWriter](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) may send data.

### ReturnCode_t wait_for_acknowledgments(const void \*const instance, const InstanceHandle_t &handle, const fastdds::dds::[Duration_t](../core/Time_t/Duration_t.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10Duration_tE) &max_wait)

Block the current thread until the writer has received the acknowledgment corresponding to the given instance. Operations performed on the same instance while the current thread is waiting will not be taken into consideration, i.e. this method may return `RETCODE_OK` with those operations unacknowledged.

* **Parameters:**
  * **instance** – Sample used to deduce instance’s key in case of `handle` parameter is HANDLE_NIL. 
  * **handle** – Instance handle of the data. 
  * **max_wait** – Maximum blocking time for this operation.
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_NOT_ENABLED if the writer has not been enabled. 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_BAD_PARAMETER if `instance` is not a valid pointer. 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_PRECONDITION_NOT_MET if the topic does not have a key, the key is unknown to the writer, or the key is not consistent with `handle`. 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_OK if the [DataWriter](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) received the acknowledgments before the time expired. 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_TIMEOUT otherwise.

### ReturnCode_t set_sample_prefilter(std::shared_ptr<[IContentFilter](../topic/icontentfilter.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds14IContentFilterE)> prefilter)

Set a sample prefilter to be used. This filter is always evaluated before sending the sample to any [DataReader](../subscriber/datareader.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataReader) and prior to any content filtering. Passing a nullptr disables prefiltering.

* **Parameters:**

* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_OK if the prefilter is set correctly.

### ReturnCode_t set_related_datareader(const [DataReader](../subscriber/datareader.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10DataReaderE) \*related_reader)

This operation sets the key of the [DataReader](../subscriber/datareader.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataReader) that is related to this [DataWriter](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter). This is used to establish a relationship between a [DataReader](../subscriber/datareader.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataReader) and a [DataWriter](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) in the context of RPC over DDS.

#### WARNING
This operation is only valid if the entity is not enabled.

* **Parameters:**
  **related_reader** – **[in]** Pointer to the [DataReader](../subscriber/datareader.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataReader) to set as related.
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_OK if the key is set successfully. 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_ILLEGAL_OPERATION if this entity is enabled. 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_PRECONDITION_NOT_MET if the entity does not belong to the same participant. 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_BAD_PARAMETER if the provided GUID is unknown or the pointer is not valid. 

### ReturnCode_t set_type_support_context(const std::shared_ptr<[TopicDataType](../topic/topicdatatype.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds13TopicDataTypeE)::[Context](../topic/topicdatatype.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds13TopicDataType7ContextE)> &context)

Set the type support context to be used when serializing data for this [DataWriter](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter). Cannot be called on an enabled [DataWriter](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter). 

* **Parameters:**
  **context** – **[in]** Shared pointer to the context to be used when serializing data.
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_OK if the context is set successfully. RETCODE_ILLEGAL_OPERATION if this entity is enabled.

# DataWriterQos

### class DataWriterQos

Class [DataWriterQos](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriterQos), containing all the possible Qos that can be set for a determined [DataWriter](datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter). Although these values can be and are transmitted during the Endpoint Discovery Protocol, not all of the behaviour associated with them has been implemented in the library. Please consult each of them to check for implementation details and default values. 

Subclassed by [eprosima::fastdds::statistics::dds::DataWriterQos](../../statistics/datawriter_qos.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1statistics_1_1dds_1_1DataWriterQos)

# Publisher

### class Publisher : public eprosima::fastdds::dds::[DomainEntity](../core/domainentity.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds12DomainEntityE)

Class [Publisher](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Publisher), used to send data to associated subscribers. 

### Public Functions

### virtual ~Publisher()

Destructor. 

### virtual ReturnCode_t enable() override

This operation enables the [Publisher](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Publisher). 

* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_OK is successfully enabled. RETCODE_PRECONDITION_NOT_MET if the participant creating this [Publisher](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Publisher) is not enabled. 

### const [PublisherQos](publisherqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds12PublisherQosE) &get_qos() const

* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_OK 

### ReturnCode_t set_qos(const [PublisherQos](publisherqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds12PublisherQosE) &qos)

Allows modifying the [Publisher](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Publisher) Qos. The given Qos must be supported by the [PublisherQos](publisherqos.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1PublisherQos).

* **Parameters:**
  **qos** – [PublisherQos](publisherqos.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1PublisherQos) to be set 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_IMMUTABLE_POLICY if any of the Qos cannot be changed, RETCODE_INCONSISTENT_POLICY if the Qos is not self consistent and RETCODE_OK if the qos is changed correctly.

### [DataWriter](datawriter.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10DataWriterE) \*create_datawriter([Topic](../topic/topic_class.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds5TopicE) \*topic, const [DataWriterQos](datawriterqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds13DataWriterQosE) &qos, [DataWriterListener](datawriterlistener.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds18DataWriterListenerE) \*listener = nullptr, const [StatusMask](../core/status/statusmask.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10StatusMaskE) &mask = [StatusMask](../core/status/statusmask.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10StatusMaskE)::[all](../core/status/statusmask.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10StatusMask3allEv)(), std::shared_ptr<fastdds::rtps::[IPayloadPool](../../rtps/history/IPayloadPool.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds4rtps12IPayloadPoolE)> payload_pool = nullptr)

This operation creates a [DataWriter](datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter). The returned [DataWriter](datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) will be attached and belongs to the [Publisher](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Publisher).

* **Parameters:**
  * **topic** – [Topic](../topic/topic_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Topic) the [DataWriter](datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) will be listening 
  * **qos** – QoS of the [DataWriter](datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter). 
  * **listener** – Pointer to the listener (default: nullptr). 
  * **mask** – [StatusMask](../core/status/statusmask.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1StatusMask) that holds statuses the listener responds to (default: all). 
  * **payload_pool** – IPayloadPool shared pointer that defines writer payload (default: nullptr). 
* **Returns:**
  Pointer to the created [DataWriter](datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter). nullptr if failed. 

### [DataWriter](datawriter.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10DataWriterE) \*create_datawriter_with_profile([Topic](../topic/topic_class.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds5TopicE) \*topic, const std::string &profile_name, [DataWriterListener](datawriterlistener.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds18DataWriterListenerE) \*listener = nullptr, const [StatusMask](../core/status/statusmask.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10StatusMaskE) &mask = [StatusMask](../core/status/statusmask.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10StatusMaskE)::[all](../core/status/statusmask.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10StatusMask3allEv)(), std::shared_ptr<fastdds::rtps::[IPayloadPool](../../rtps/history/IPayloadPool.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds4rtps12IPayloadPoolE)> payload_pool = nullptr)

This operation creates a [DataWriter](datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter). The returned [DataWriter](datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) will be attached and belongs to the [Publisher](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Publisher).

* **Parameters:**
  * **topic** – [Topic](../topic/topic_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Topic) the [DataWriter](datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) will be listening 
  * **profile_name** – [DataWriter](datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) profile name. 
  * **listener** – Pointer to the listener (default: nullptr). 
  * **mask** – [StatusMask](../core/status/statusmask.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1StatusMask) that holds statuses the listener responds to (default: all). 
  * **payload_pool** – IPayloadPool shared pointer that defines writer payload (default: nullptr). 
* **Returns:**
  Pointer to the created [DataWriter](datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter). nullptr if failed. 

### ReturnCode_t delete_datawriter(const [DataWriter](datawriter.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10DataWriterE) \*writer)

This operation deletes a [DataWriter](datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) that belongs to the [Publisher](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Publisher).

The delete_datawriter operation must be called on the same [Publisher](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Publisher) object used to create the [DataWriter](datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter). If delete_datawriter is called on a different [Publisher](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Publisher), the operation will have no effect and it will return false.

The deletion of the [DataWriter](datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) will automatically unregister all instances. Depending on the settings of the WRITER_DATA_LIFECYCLE [QosPolicy](../core/policy/qospolicy.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1QosPolicy), the deletion of the [DataWriter](datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) may also dispose all instances.

* **Parameters:**
  **writer** – [DataWriter](datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) to delete 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_PRECONDITION_NOT_MET if it does not belong to this [Publisher](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Publisher), RETCODE_OK if it is correctly deleted and RETCODE_ERROR otherwise. 

### [DataWriter](datawriter.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10DataWriterE) \*lookup_datawriter(const std::string &topic_name) const

This operation retrieves a previously created [DataWriter](datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) belonging to the [Publisher](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Publisher) that is attached to a [Topic](../topic/topic_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Topic) with a matching topic_name. If no such [DataWriter](datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) exists, the operation will return nullptr.

If multiple [DataWriter](datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) attached to the [Publisher](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Publisher) satisfy this condition, then the operation will return one of them. It is not specified which one.

* **Parameters:**
  **topic_name** – Name of the [Topic](../topic/topic_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Topic)
* **Returns:**
  Pointer to a previously created [DataWriter](datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) associated to a [Topic](../topic/topic_class.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Topic) with the requested topic_name

### ReturnCode_t wait_for_acknowledgments(const fastdds::dds::[Duration_t](../core/Time_t/Duration_t.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds10Duration_tE) &max_wait)

This operation blocks the calling thread until either all data written by the reliable [DataWriter](datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) entities is acknowledged by all matched reliable [DataReader](../subscriber/datareader.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataReader) entities, or else the duration specified by the max_wait parameter elapses, whichever happens first. A return value of true indicates that all the samples written have been acknowledged by all reliable matched data readers; a return value of false indicates that max_wait elapsed before all the data was acknowledged.

* **Parameters:**
  **max_wait** – Maximum blocking time for this operation 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_TIMEOUT if the function takes more than the maximum blocking time established, RETCODE_OK if the [Publisher](#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1Publisher) receives the acknowledgments and RETCODE_ERROR otherwise.

### ReturnCode_t set_default_datawriter_qos(const [DataWriterQos](datawriterqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds13DataWriterQosE) &qos)

This operation sets a default value of the [DataWriter](datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) QoS policies which will be used for newly created [DataWriter](datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) entities in the case where the QoS policies are defaulted in the create_datawriter operation.

This operation will check that the resulting policies are self consistent; if they are not, the operation will have no effect and return false.

The special value DATAWRITER_QOS_DEFAULT may be passed to this operation to indicate that the default QoS should be reset back to the initial values the factory would use, that is the values that would be used if the set_default_datawriter_qos operation had never been called.

* **Parameters:**
  **qos** – [DataWriterQos](datawriterqos.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriterQos) to be set 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_INCONSISTENT_POLICY if the Qos is not self consistent and RETCODE_OK if the qos is changed correctly. 

### const [DataWriterQos](datawriterqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds13DataWriterQosE) &get_default_datawriter_qos() const

This operation returns the default value of the [DataWriter](datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) QoS, that is, the QoS policies which will be used for newly created [DataWriter](datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) entities in the case where the QoS policies are defaulted in the create_datawriter operation.

The values retrieved by get_default_datawriter_qos will match the set of values specified on the last successful call to set_default_datawriter_qos, or else, if the call was never made, the default values.

* **Returns:**
  Current default WriterQos

### ReturnCode_t get_default_datawriter_qos([DataWriterQos](datawriterqos.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds13DataWriterQosE) &qos) const

This operation retrieves the default value of the [DataWriter](datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) QoS, that is, the QoS policies which will be used for newly created [DataWriter](datawriter.md#classeprosima_1_1fastdds_1_1dds_1_1DataWriter) entities in the case where the QoS policies are defaulted in the create_datawriter operation.

The values retrieved by get_default_datawriter_qos will match the set of values specified on the last successful call to set_default_datawriter_qos, or else, if the call was never made, the default values.

* **Parameters:**
  **qos** – Reference to the current default WriterQos. 
* **Returns:**
  RETCODE_OK

# PublisherListener

### class PublisherListener : public eprosima::fastdds::dds::[DataWriterListener](datawriterlistener.md#_CPPv4N8eprosima7fastdds3dds18DataWriterListenerE)
